That’s why Scripture says, “When he went up to his place on high, he brought many prisoners and gave gifts to his people.”
What does “he went up” mean? It can only mean that he also went down to the lower, earthly places.
The one who came down is the same one who went up. He went up higher than all the heavens, in order to fill the whole creation.
So Christ himself has given apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors, and teachers as gifts to the church.
They all train God’s people to serve so that the body of Christ will be built up,
until we are all united in our faith and our knowledge of God’s Son and we become grown up, mature, and completely filled with Christ.

Then we won’t be babies in the faith anymore. We won’t be like ships tossed around by the waves and blown here and there by every new teaching. We won’t be fooled by the tricks that people use to hide their real plans.
Instead, we’ll speak the truth in love and grow up in every way to become the body of Christ. Christ is the head
who makes the whole body grow and build itself up in love. Each part of the body does its work in connection and cooperation with all the other parts.

verses.heading: Teachings for Living as Christians
verses.text: So let me tell you—and I’m speaking for the Lord as I warn you: You must not live the way the Gentiles do any longer. They’re not able to think things through correctly.
They have only a dim understanding, and they don’t appreciate what it’s like to follow God. They’re ignorant because their hearts are stubborn.
They’ve lost all feeling for what is right, and so they allow themselves to indulge in all kinds of wrong pleasures. They take part in every kind of unclean act, and they’re full of greed.
But that’s not the way of life you learned
when you heard about Christ and were taught about him, according to the truth that is in Jesus.
You were taught not to live the way you used to, but to get rid of that old way of life, which was corrupted by its deceptive desires.
You were taught to be made new in your thinking
and start living a new life, one created to be truly good and holy like God.
So each of you must stop lying, and you must speak the truth to your neighbor, because we are all part of the same body.
Scripture says, “If you get angry, don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down while you’re still angry.
If you stay mad at someone all night long, that will give the devil an opportunity.
Anyone who used to steal must never steal again. Instead, they should work, doing something useful with their own hands, so that they will have something to share with people in need.
Don’t let any foul language come out of your mouths. Say only what will help build others up and meet their needs. Then what you say will help those who are listening.
Do not grieve God’s Holy Spirit. The Holy Spirit is the proof that you belong to God and that God will set you completely free one day.
Get rid of all bitterness, anger, rage, fighting, lying, and any kind of hatred.
Instead, be kind and merciful to one another. Forgive one another, just as God has forgiven you in Christ.
Follow God’s example, as children that he loves dearly,
and follow the path of love. That’s what Christ did. He loved us and gave himself up for us as a sweet-smelling offering and sacrifice to God.
There shouldn’t be even a hint of any sexual sin among you, or of anything impure or greedy, because those are not the kinds of things that God’s holy people should do.
There must not be any bad language or foolish talk or dirty jokes. Those are inappropriate. Instead, you should give thanks.
You can be sure that no one who’s immoral, impure, or greedy will receive a share in the kingdom of Christ and of God, because they’re really serving a false god.
Don’t listen to anyone’s excuses for living like that, because it’s disobedience, and it makes God very angry.
So don’t take part in things like that.
You used to be darkness, but now you’re light in the Lord. Live as children of the light.
The light produces what is completely good, right, and true.
So find out what pleases the Lord,
and don’t have anything to do with the acts of darkness. They never produce anything good. Show what those acts are really like.
It’s shameful even to talk about what disobedient people do in secret.
But everything that’s brought into the light can be seen for what it really is. And everything that the light shines on becomes a light itself.
That’s why it’s said, “Wake up, sleeper, rise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
So be very careful how you live. Don’t live as people who aren’t wise; live as people who are wise.
Make the most of every opportunity, because the days are evil.
So don’t be foolish. Instead, understand what the Lord wants.
Don’t get drunk with wine, which leads to wild living. Instead, be filled with the Spirit.
Speak to one another with psalms, hymns, and songs from the Spirit. Sing and make music from your heart to the Lord,
always giving thanks to God the Father for everything in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.heading: Teachings for Christian Families
verses.text: Follow one another’s lead out of respect for Christ.
Wives, follow the lead of your own husbands as a way of following the Lord’s lead.
The husband is the head of the wife, just as Christ is the head of the church. The church is Christ’s body and he is its Savior.
The church follows the lead of Christ, and in the same way, wives should follow the lead of their husbands in everything.
Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave himself up for her.
He did this to make her holy, washing her with water through the word.
That way he could present her to himself as a radiant church that had no stain or wrinkle or any other flaw, but was holy and blameless.
In the same way, husbands should love their wives as they love their own bodies. Any man who loves his wife loves himself.
After all, no man ever hated his own body. Instead, he feeds and cares for it. And this is what Christ does for the church,
because we are parts of his body.
Scripture says, “That’s why a man will leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two will become one.”
That is a great mystery, and I’m applying it here to Christ and the church.
But the point remains that a husband must also love his wife, just as he loves himself, and a wife must respect her husband.
Children, obey your parents as a way of obeying the Lord. That’s the right thing to do.
Scripture says, “Honor your father and mother.” That’s the first commandment that has a promise:
“Then things will go well with you, and you’ll live a long time on the earth.”
Fathers, don’t frustrate your children to the point where they get angry. Instead, instruct them and teach them the ways of the Lord as you raise them.
Slaves, obey your masters here on earth. Sincerely respect and honor them. Obey them as a way of obeying Christ.
And don’t obey them just to please them when they’re watching, but in order to do the will of God genuinely, as slaves of Christ.
Serve your masters with all your heart, as if you were serving the Lord and not people.
You know that the Lord will give each one a reward for whatever good they do, whether they’re a slave or a free person.

Masters, treat your slaves with the same kind of respect. Don’t threaten them, because you know that God, who is their Master and yours, is in heaven. He doesn’t let people get away with things just because of their positions.

verses.heading: God’s Armor for Believers
verses.text: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in his mighty power.
Put on all of God’s armor so that you can fight back against the devil’s tricks.
We’re not fighting against human beings, but against the rulers, authorities, and powers of this dark world and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly world.
So put on all of God’s armor, so that when evil days come, you’ll be able to stand up to anything. After you’ve done everything you can, you’ll still be standing.
So stand firm, buckle the belt of truth around your waist, put the armor of godliness on your chest,
and wear on your feet the readiness to share the good news of peace.
Also, carry the shield of faith, because with it you can put out all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
Put on the helmet of salvation, and take the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.
Pray in the Spirit at all times, making all kinds of prayers and requests. Stay alert and always keep praying for all the Lord’s people.
Pray also for me, that whenever I speak, the right words will be given to me so I can explain the mystery of the good news boldly.
Because of the good news, I’m being held in chains as the Lord’s messenger. So pray that I will preach the good news boldly, as I should.

verses.heading: Final Greetings
verses.text: Tychicus, our dear brother and the Lord’s faithful servant, will tell you all the news about me. Then you’ll know how I am and what I’m doing.
I’m sending him to you because I want you to know how we are and because I want him to encourage you.
May God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give all of you brothers and sisters peace, love, and faith.
And may grace be given to everyone who loves our Lord Jesus Christ with a love that never dies.
From Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus. To all of God’s holy people in Christ Jesus in Philippi, together with your leaders and deacons.
May God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.

verses.heading: Paul Prays and Gives Thanks
verses.text: I thank my God every time I remember you.
In all my prayers for you, I always pray with joy
because you’ve joined me in spreading the good news. You’ve done so from the time you first believed until now.
And I’m confident that God, who has begun a good work in you, will carry it on until it’s completed on the day when Christ Jesus returns.

It’s right for me to feel this way about all of you. You have a special place in my heart. Whether I’m being held in chains or standing up for the truth of the good news, either way, all of you share together in God’s grace with me.
God is my witness that I long for all of you with the love of Christ Jesus.
And so I pray that your love will grow more and more in knowledge and understanding.
Then you’ll be able to recognize the things that are best, and you’ll be pure and blameless on the day when Christ returns.
You’ll be filled with the fruit of right living that comes from following Jesus Christ. All of these things bring glory and praise to God.

verses.heading: Paul Spreads the Good News While in Prison
verses.subheading: Paul Spreads the Good News While in Prison
verses.text: I want you to know, brothers and sisters, that what has happened to me has actually helped spread the good news.
It’s clear I’m being held in chains because I’m a witness for Christ. All of the palace guards know this, and so does everyone else here.
Because I’m a prisoner, most of the brothers and sisters have become much bolder in the Lord, and they’re not afraid to preach the good news.
It’s true that some are preaching about Christ because they’re jealous of me. But others are preaching about Christ to help me in my work.
They’re acting out of love, knowing that I’ve been placed here to defend the good news.
The jealous ones are preaching about Christ out of selfish ambition; they’re not doing it sincerely. They think they can create trouble for me while I’m being held in chains.
But what does it matter? The important thing is that whether for good reasons or bad ones, Christ is being preached. And that makes me very glad. And I’ll continue to be glad,
because I know you’re praying for me and that God will give me the Spirit of Jesus Christ to help me. No matter what happens, I’ll be set free.
I truly expect and hope that I won’t be ashamed in any way, but that I’ll be brave enough so that now as always, Christ will be honored in my body, whether I live or die.
As I see it, if I live, I live for Christ, and if I die, I get something even better than this life.
If I go on living in my body, then I’ll be able to carry on my work, and it will bear a lot of fruit. But which one should I choose? I don’t know.
I can’t decide between the two. I long to depart and be with Christ. That would be better by far.
But it would help you more if I stayed in this body.
Since I’m convinced of that, I know I’ll stay with you and continue to help you grow and be joyful in your faith.
I’m confident that I’ll be able to come see you again, and then you’ll be able to boast in Christ Jesus even more because of me.

verses.heading: Living to Honor the Good News
verses.subheading: Living to Honor the Good News
verses.text: But no matter what happens, live in a way that brings honor to the good news about Christ. Then, whether I come and see you or only hear about you, I’ll know that you’re standing firm together in the one Spirit and that you’re fighting together as a unit to defend the good news.
So don’t be afraid in any way of those who oppose you. Your fearlessness will show them that they’re going to be destroyed but you’re going to be saved.
You’ve been given the privilege, for the sake of Christ, not only of believing in him but also of suffering for him.
You’re going through the same struggle that you saw me go through and that you hear I’m going through now.

verses.heading: Being Humble Like Christ
verses.text: If belonging to Christ helps you, if his love comforts you, if you share anything in common because of the Holy Spirit, if Christ has been gentle and loving toward you,
then make my joy complete by agreeing with one another. Have the same love and be unified in spirit and mind.
Don’t try to get ahead of others, and don’t think you’re better than they are. Instead, be humble and honor others more than yourselves.
Don’t look out just for your own good. Instead, look out for the good of others.
In your relationships with one another, have the same attitude that Jesus did.
He actually was God, but he didn’t take advantage of the fact that he was equal with God.
Instead, he made himself nothing by taking on the nature of a servant and becoming just like human beings.
He appeared on earth as a man, and he humbled himself and obeyed God completely. He did this even though it led to his death. Even worse, he died on a cross!
So God lifted him up to the highest place and gave him the name that is above every name.
When the name of Jesus is spoken, everyone will kneel to worship, in heaven and on earth and under the earth,
and everyone will acknowledge Jesus Christ as Lord. And God the Father will receive the glory.

verses.heading: Live Without Complaining
verses.text: And so, my dear friends, as you’ve always obeyed God—not just while I was with you, but even more now that I’m not with you— continue to work out your own salvation. Do it with fear and trembling.
God is at work in you to help you both to want his good purpose and to work for it.
Do everything without complaining or arguing.
Then you’ll be pure and blameless, “children of God without fault in the midst of a crooked and twisted generation.” Then you’ll shine within your generation like stars in the universe
as you hold on to the word of life. Then I’ll be able to boast on the day when Christ returns that I didn’t run or work for nothing.
But even if my life is going to be poured out like a drink offering on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I’ll be glad and joyful with all of you.
So you too should be glad and joyful with me.

verses.heading: Timothy and Epaphroditus
verses.text: I hope to send Timothy to you soon, if the Lord Jesus allows it. That way I’ll be encouraged when I receive news about you.
I have no one else like Timothy. He will truly care about how you’re doing.
All the others are looking out for their own interests, not for the interests of Jesus Christ.
But you know that Timothy has proved himself. He has served with me like a son with his father in spreading the good news.
So I hope to send him as soon as I see how things go with me.
And I’m confident that I will come soon myself, if the Lord allows it.

But I think it’s necessary to send Epaphroditus back to you now. He’s my brother in the Lord, and he’s a worker and a soldier for Christ together with me. He’s also your messenger, because you sent him to take care of my needs.
He misses all of you, and he’s distressed because you heard he was sick.
Actually, he was very sick. He almost died! But God had mercy on him, and also on me. God spared me the sorrow of losing him on top of all my other sorrows here.
So I want even more to send him to you, so that when you see him again, you’ll be encouraged and I won’t be so concerned.
So then, welcome him as a brother in the Lord with great joy. Honor people like him.
He almost died for the work of Christ. He risked his life by coming here to provide the help you couldn’t give me yourselves because you were so far away.

verses.heading: Don’t Trust in Who You Are or What You Can Do
verses.subheading: Don’t Trust in Who You Are or What You Can Do
verses.text: Beyond this, my brothers and sisters, rejoice in the Lord! I don’t mind writing the same things to you again, as this protects you.
Watch out for those dogs, those bad people, those ones who just want to cut the body.

We’re the ones who have truly been circumcised: We serve God by his Spirit, we boast in Christ Jesus, and we don’t put our trust in who we are or what we can do—although I myself could do that for many reasons.
Others may think they have reasons to trust in those things, but I have even more.
I was circumcised on the eighth day. I’m part of the people of Israel. I’m from the tribe of Benjamin. I’m a pure Hebrew.
As for being strict about the law, I’m a Pharisee. As for zeal, I opposed and attacked the church. As far as keeping the law is concerned, I kept it perfectly.
I thought that things like that were real advantages. But now I consider them to be worthless because of Christ.

In fact, I consider everything to be worthless compared with knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. Knowing him is worth much more than anything else. Because of him I’ve lost everything, but I look at it all as garbage so that I can know Christ better.
I want to belong to him, and I want to be right with God based not on my obedience to the law but on my faith in Christ.
I want to know Christ and the power that raised him from the dead and what it means to join him in his sufferings. I want to become like him in his death
so that by God’s grace I can also rise from the dead.
I haven’t yet received these things or reached my goal. But Christ Jesus took hold of me so that I could reach it, and so I keep pushing myself forward to take hold of it.
Brothers and sisters, I don’t consider that I’ve taken hold of it yet. But here’s the one thing I do: Forgetting what’s behind me and pushing toward what’s ahead of me,
I press on toward the goal to win the prize, because God has called me toward heaven in Christ Jesus in order to win it.

verses.heading: Following Paul’s Example
verses.text: So all of us who are mature in the faith should see things this way. If you think differently about something, God will make that clear to you.
Just make sure that you live up to what you’ve already reached.
Brothers and sisters, join together in following my example. You have us as a model, so pay close attention to those who live the way we do.
I’ve told you these things many times before, and I’m telling you them again with tears in my eyes. Many people live like enemies of the cross of Christ.
Their destiny is destruction, their god is their stomach, and they brag about things they should be ashamed of. They only think about earthly things.
But we’re citizens of heaven, and we’re waiting eagerly for a Savior from there, the Lord Jesus Christ.
He has the power to bring everything under his control, and by that power he’ll change our earthly bodies to become like his glorious body.

verses.heading: Remain Strong in the Lord
verses.text: My brothers and sisters, stand firm in the Lord in this way. I love you and miss you, dear friends. You’re my joy and my crown.
I want to urge Euodia and Syntyche to work together in the Lord.

And I urge you, my true companion, to help these women, because they’ve worked with me to spread the good news. So has Clement, and so have the rest of those who’ve worked together with me. Their names are all written in the book of life.

verses.heading: Final Commands
verses.text: Always rejoice in the Lord. I’ll say it again: Rejoice!
Let everyone see how gentle you are. The Lord is coming soon.
Don’t worry about anything, but in every situation, pray and give thanks to God and ask him to help you.
Then, in a way that’s too marvelous to understand, God’s peace will guard your hearts and minds in Christ Jesus.
Finally, my brothers and sisters, whatever is noble, right, and pure, whatever is lovely and worthy of respect, if anything is excellent or worthy of praise, think about those things.
Whatever you’ve learned or received or heard from me, or seen in me, put into practice. And the God of peace will be with you.

verses.heading: Paul Thanks the Philippians for Their Gifts
verses.subheading: Paul Thanks the Philippians for Their Gifts
verses.text: You’ve made me very happy by sending me another gift. I know you were concerned about me all along, but you didn’t have the opportunity to send me anything until now.
I’m not saying this because I need something. I’ve learned how to be content in any situation.

I know what it’s like not to have the things I need, and I know what it’s like to have more than I need. I’ve learned the secret of being content in any circumstances. I’m content whether I’m well fed or hungry, whether I have more than enough or I don’t have enough.
I can do all this through the one who gives me strength.
But it was good of you to share in my troubles.
You believers at Philippi know what happened when I left Macedonia in the early days when you first heard the good news. Not one church helped me in the matter of giving and receiving except for you.
Even when I was in Thessalonica, you sent me help when I needed it, and you did that more than once.
It’s not that I want your gifts. I want greater and greater rewards to be stored up for you.

I’ve already received my full pay, and I have more than enough. I have everything I need, now that Epaphroditus has brought me the gifts you sent. They’re a sweet-smelling offering, a sacrifice that God accepts and that makes him happy.
And my God will meet all of your needs from his wonderful riches, which are yours in Christ Jesus.
May our God and Father receive glory forever and ever! Amen.

verses.heading: Final Greetings
verses.text: Greet all of God’s people in Christ Jesus. The brothers and sisters who are with me send greetings.
All of God’s people here send you greetings, particularly those who work in the emperor’s palace.
May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.
From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and our brother Timothy.
To God’s holy people in Colossae, the faithful brothers and sisters in Christ. May God our Father give you grace and peace.

verses.heading: Paul Prays and Gives Thanks
verses.text: We always thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, when we pray for you,
because we’ve heard about your faith in Christ Jesus and your love for all of God’s people.
Your faith and love come from the hope that’s stored up for you in heaven. You’ve already heard about it in the true message of the good news
that has come to you. In the same way, the good news is bearing fruit and growing all over the world, as it has been doing among you since the day you heard it and truly understood God’s grace.
You heard the good news from Epaphras, our dear friend who faithfully serves Christ with us.
He has told us about the love you have from the Holy Spirit.

For this reason, we’ve been praying for you since the day we heard about you. We keep asking God to fill you with the knowledge of his will through all the wisdom and understanding that the Spirit gives.
Then you’ll be able to lead a life that is worthy of the Lord and please him in every way. You’ll bear fruit in every good thing you do, you’ll get to know God better,
and you’ll be strong, in keeping with his glorious power. You’ll be patient and never give up.
You’ll give thanks joyfully to the Father, who has entitled you to share in what he’ll give to all his holy people in the kingdom of light.
He has saved us from the dominion of darkness and brought us into the kingdom of the Son he loves.
Because of what the Son has done, we’ve been set free and all our sins have been forgiven.

verses.heading: The Son of God Is Better Than Everything Else
verses.subheading: The Son of God Is Better Than Everything Else
verses.text: The Son is the exact likeness of God, who can’t be seen. The Son is the first, and he’s over all creation.
All things were created in him: everything in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible, all kings, powers, rulers, and authorities; all things have been created by him and for him.
Before anything was created, he was already there. He holds everything together,
and he is the head of the body, which is the church. He is the beginning, the first to be raised from the dead. That happened so that he would be far above everything.
God was pleased to have his whole fullness living in Christ
and to bring all things back to himself through what Christ has done, everything on earth and in heaven. God made peace through Christ’s blood, by his death on the cross.
At one time you were separated from God. In your minds, you were his enemies, because of your wrong ways.
But through Christ’s death, God has brought you back to himself and made you holy in his own sight. So now you don’t have any flaws and you’re free from blame.

But you must keep your faith steady and firm and not move away from the hope that the good news is offering you. This is the good news that you heard. It has been preached to every creature under heaven and I, Paul, am its servant.

verses.heading: Paul’s Work for the Church
verses.text: I’m joyful because of what I’m suffering for you. My suffering continues the sufferings of Christ for his body, which is the church.
God appointed me to serve the church and bring the entire word of God to you.
It contains the mystery that has been hidden for many ages but that has now been made known to the Lord’s people.
God has chosen to make known to them the glorious riches of that mystery among the Gentiles. And here’s what it is: Christ is in you, the hope of glory.
Christ is the one we preach about. With all the wisdom we have, we warn and teach everyone so that when we bring them to God, they will be like Christ. We want them to be mature in Christ.
I work hard for that with all the strength of Christ that works powerfully within me.
I want you to know how hard I’m working for you and for those who are in Laodicea and for everyone who hasn’t met me in person.
My goal is that they will all be encouraged in their hearts and joined together in love. Then their understanding will be rich and complete, and they will know the mystery of God, which is Christ.
All the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden in him.
I tell you this so that no one will mislead you with deceptive arguments.
Even though I’m away from you in body, I’m with you in spirit, and I am glad to see that you’re well-disciplined and that your faith in Christ is so strong.

verses.heading: Having All Things in Christ
verses.text: So then, just as you received Christ Jesus as Lord, keep on living your lives in him.
Put down deep roots and build yourselves up in him. Grow strong in your faith, just as you were taught, and overflow with thanksgiving.
Make sure that no one makes you their prisoner through false and deceptive reasoning, through ideas that depend on human teachings and the basic spiritual powers of this world rather than on Christ.
All the fullness of God is living in Christ in human form.
Because you belong to Christ, you have been made complete. He is the ruler over every power and authority.

In Christ, you have received a circumcision that has not been done by human hands. Your circumcision has been done by Christ, and he has put away the person you used to be when wrong desires ruled over you.
When you were baptized, you were buried together with Christ, and you were raised to life with him by believing in the work that God did when he raised Jesus from the dead.
At one time you were dead in your sins, and your wrong desires were not circumcised. But God gave you new life together with Christ. He forgave us all our sins
and cancelled the debt that the law said we owed. That debt counted against us and made us guilty, but God took it away and nailed it to the cross.
Jesus disarmed the spiritual powers and authorities of this world and publicly defeated them by dying on the cross.

verses.heading: Freedom From Human Rules
verses.text: So don’t let anyone judge you because of what you eat or drink or because of how you approach holy days such as special feasts and New Moons and Sabbath days.
Those were only a shadow of the things that were coming; now the reality is found in Christ.

Some people pretend to be humble, and they worship angels. But don’t let people like that judge you. These people tell you in great detail about the visions they’ve seen, and they’re conceited because of all the ideas they have. But their ideas are really useless, because their minds aren’t guided by the Holy Spirit.
These people aren’t connected anymore to the head, who is Christ. God makes the whole body grow as it’s guided by the head and held together by its tendons and ligaments.

Some people still follow the basic spiritual powers of the world. But you died with Christ as far as those powers are concerned. So why do you act as if you still belonged to the world? You’re following rules such as,
“Don’t handle! Don’t taste! Don’t touch!”
Rules like those are about things that will soon pass away. They’re based on merely human rules and teachings.

It’s true that these rules seem to make sense. They lead people to have a regular schedule of worship, at least to act as if they’re humble, and to be severe with their bodies. But these rules don’t do anything to stop people from giving in to their wrong desires.

verses.heading: Teachings About Holy Living
verses.text: Since you have been raised with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is sitting at God’s right hand.
Think about things that are above, not about things that are only on earth.
You have died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God.
When Christ, who is your life, appears, then you also will appear with him in glory.
So put to death anything that comes from your wrong desires: sexual immorality, impurity, lust, evil desires, and greed, which is idolatry.
Because of these things, God is going to punish the world.
That’s the way you lived at one time in your life.
But now you must also get rid of things like anger, rage, hatred, lies, and dirty language.
Don’t lie to one another, since you’ve gotten rid of the old way of life with its habits
and started living a new life. Your life is being made new in knowledge in the Creator’s likeness.
In that likeness, there’s no Gentile or Jew, circumcised or uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave, or free. Christ is all, and he is in all.
As God’s chosen people, holy and dearly loved, put on tender mercy, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience as if they were new clothes.
Put up with one another and, if you’re holding something against someone, forgive each other, just as the Lord forgave you.
Over all these good things put on love, which holds them all together perfectly as if they were one.
Let the peace that Christ gives rule in your hearts, since as parts of one body, you were called to peace. And be thankful.
Let the message about Christ live among you richly as you teach and correct one another with great wisdom. Sing psalms and hymns and songs from the Spirit to God with gratitude in your hearts.
And whatever you say or do, let it be in the name of the Lord Jesus, as you give thanks to God the Father through him.

verses.heading: Teachings About Christian Families
verses.text: Wives, follow the lead of your husbands, as is appropriate in the Lord.
Husbands, love your wives and don’t be mean to them.
Children, obey your parents in everything. That pleases the Lord.
Fathers, don’t make your children bitter. If you do, they’ll lose hope.
Slaves, obey your earthly masters in everything. Don’t do it just to please them when they’re watching you. Obey them genuinely, out of respect for the Lord.
Work at everything you do with all your heart, as if you were working for the Lord, not for human masters.
You know that in the end you’ll receive the reward that the Lord wants you to have. You’re slaves of the Lord Christ.
Anyone who does wrong will be paid back for what they’ve done. God doesn’t give anyone special privileges.
Masters, give your slaves what is right and fair, because you know that you also have a Master in heaven.

verses.heading: More Teachings
verses.text: Spend a lot of time and effort in prayer. Always be alert to what you should be praying for, and always give thanks for answered prayer.
Pray for us too. Ask God to open a door for our message so that we can preach the mystery of Christ, for which I’m being held in chains.
Pray that I will preach it clearly, as I should.
Be wise in the way you act toward outsiders. Make the most of every opportunity.
Learn how to speak with people graciously, using just the right words. That way you’ll know how to answer everyone.

verses.heading: Final Greetings
verses.text: Tychicus will tell you all the news about me. He’s a dear brother, a faithful worker, and a servant of the Lord together with us.
I’m sending him to you specifically because I want you to know what’s happening here, and I want him to encourage you and strengthen your hearts.
He’s coming with Onesimus, our faithful and dear brother, who’s from your community. They’ll tell you everything that’s happening here.
Aristarchus, who’s in prison with me, sends you his greetings. So does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. You’ve been given directions about him. If he comes to you, welcome him.
Jesus, who is called Justus, also sends greetings. These are the only Jews who are working together with me for God’s kingdom, and they’ve been a comfort to me.

Epaphras, who’s from your community and who’s a servant of Christ Jesus, sends greetings. He’s always praying hard for you, that you’ll stand firm in the will of God and that you’ll be confident and mature.
I can assure you that he’s working very hard for you and for everyone in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
Our dear friend Luke, the doctor, sends greetings, and so does Demas.
Give my greetings to the brothers and sisters in Laodicea. Also give my greetings to Nympha and the church that meets in her house.
After this letter has been read to you, make sure that it’s read to the church in Laodicea. I sent them a letter also; make sure that you have that one read in your church too.
Tell Archippus, “Be sure to complete the work the Lord has given you to do.”
I, Paul, am writing this greeting with my own hand. Remember that I’m being held in chains. May God’s grace be with you.
From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. Grace and peace to you.

verses.heading: Paul Gives Thanks for the Thessalonians’ Faith / Paul Gives Thanks for the Thessalonians’ Faith
verses.text: We always thank God for all of you, and we’re constantly praying for you.

Whenever we pray to our God and Father, we remember the work that your faith produces, the service that’s the result of your love, and the strength to continue that comes from your hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.
We know, brothers and sisters, that God loves you and that God has chosen you,

because our good news didn’t just come to you through our words. It came with power, with the Holy Spirit, and with great confidence. You know what we went through for your sake when we were with you.
And you imitated both us and the Lord Jesus, because even in the midst of terrible suffering, you welcomed our message with the joy that the Holy Spirit gives.
So you became a model for all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia.
The Lord’s message rang out from you, and not just in Macedonia and Achaia. Your faith in God has become known everywhere, so we don’t have to say anything about it.
All the other believers are already talking about the kind of welcome you gave us, about how you turned away from idols to serve the living and true God,
and about how you’re waiting for his Son to come from heaven. The Son is the one God raised from the dead, Jesus, and he saves us from God’s coming anger.

verses.heading: Paul’s Work for God in Thessalonica / Paul’s Work for God in Thessalonica
verses.text: Brothers and sisters, you know that our visit to you produced good results.

Earlier, in the city of Philippi, we suffered and the people treated us very badly, as you also know. But God still gave us the boldness to tell you his good news, even when people strongly opposed us.
We didn’t appeal to you out of error, or from wrong motives, or out of deceit.
No, we speak as people God has approved and entrusted with the good news. We’re not trying to please people; we’re trying to please God, who tests our hearts.
We never used flattery, as you know; we weren’t pretending to just get money from you. God is our witness that this is true.
We weren’t expecting people to praise us. We weren’t looking for praise from anybody, not from you and not from anyone else, even though we could have demanded respect as apostles of Christ.
Instead, we were like young children when we were with you. We cared for you the way a mother feeds and cares for her little children.
We loved you so much that we were happy to share with you not just God’s good news, but our own lives as well.
Brothers and sisters, I’m sure you remember how hard we worked. We labored night and day while we preached God’s good news to you so that we wouldn’t cause you any expense.
You’re witnesses, and so is God, that we led holy, godly, and blameless lives among you believers.
You know that we treated each of you the way a father treats his own children.
We encouraged you, comforted you, and urged you to live in a way worthy of God, who has called you into his kingdom and glory.

We also thank God constantly for the way you received his word when you heard it from us. You didn’t accept it as a human word, but for what it is, the word of God. And that word is truly at work in you who believe.
Brothers and sisters, you imitated the members of the synagogues in Judea that believe in Christ Jesus. You suffered from your own people the same things they suffered from the Jews,
who killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets and also forced us to leave. These Jews displease God and make enemies everywhere
by trying to keep us from speaking to the Gentiles in order that they can be saved. By doing that, they’re continually increasing their sins to the maximum. But God’s anger has come on them at last.

verses.heading: Paul’s Desire to See the Believers in Thessalonica / Paul’s Desire to See the Believers in Thessalonica
verses.text: Brothers and sisters, when for a short time we were separated from you (in person, though we were still with you in our thoughts), we felt like parents who had lost their children. We wanted to see you so much that we tried very hard to do so.
We wanted to come to you—certainly I, Paul, wanted to come again and again—but Satan blocked our way.
After all, what is our hope? What is our joy? What is the crown that we will delight in when our Lord Jesus returns? Isn’t it you?
Yes, you are our glory and our joy.

So when we couldn’t stand it any longer, we decided it would be best if we sent our brother Timothy to strengthen and encourage you in your faith, even if we had to stay here in Athens. Timothy works together with us as we serve God by spreading the good news about Christ.
We didn’t want anyone’s faith to be shaken by these times of testing, which you know very well will happen to us.
In fact, when we were with you, we kept telling you that our enemies would make us suffer, and it has turned out that way, as you know very well.
That’s why, when I couldn’t stand it any longer, I sent someone to find out about your faith. I was afraid that Satan had tempted you in some way and that our work among you had been useless.

verses.heading: Timothy Brings a Good Report / Timothy Brings a Good Report
verses.text: But just now Timothy has come to us from you, and he has brought good news about your faith and love. He has told us that you always have happy memories of us and that you long to see us just as we long to see you.
Brothers and sisters, even though we’re still in trouble and suffering, you’ve encouraged us by your faith.
Now we really live, because you’re standing firm in the Lord.
How can we thank God enough for you in return for all the joy we have in his presence because of you?
We’re praying very hard, night and day, that we’ll be able to see you again and provide what you still need for your faith.
Now may our God and Father himself and our Lord Jesus clear the way for us to come to you.
May the Lord make your love grow and overflow for one another and for everyone else, just as ours does for you.
May he strengthen your hearts so that you’ll be holy and blameless in the presence of our God and Father when our Lord Jesus comes with all his holy ones.

verses.heading: Living in a Way That Pleases God / Living in a Way That Pleases God
verses.text: Now I want to talk about some other matters, brothers and sisters. We taught you how to live in a way that pleases God, and that’s how you’re living. But in the name of the Lord Jesus, we ask you and urge you to do that more and more.
You know the directions we gave you by the authority of the Lord Jesus.
It is God’s will for you to be made holy. He wants you to stay away from sexual sins.
He wants all of you to learn to control your own bodies in a way that is holy and honorable.
Don’t desire to commit sexual sins like people who don’t know God.

None of you should sin against your brother or sister by doing that. You shouldn’t take advantage of your brother or sister. The Lord will punish everyone who commits sins like those. We’ve already told you and warned you about that.
God didn’t call us to live impure lives, but holy ones.
If anyone refuses to accept this teaching, they’re not rejecting a human being. They’re rejecting God, the very same God who gives you his Holy Spirit.
We don’t need to write to you about your love for one another, because God himself has taught you to love one another.
You do love all of God’s family throughout Macedonia. But we’re still urging you, brothers and sisters, to love one another more and more.
Do everything you can to live a quiet life. You should mind your own business and work with your hands, just as we told you to.
Then outsiders will have respect for your everyday life, and you won’t have to depend on anyone.

verses.heading: What Happens to Believers Who Have Died / What Happens to Believers Who Have Died
verses.text: Brothers and sisters, we want you to know what happens to those who die. We don’t want you to mourn, as other people do because they don’t have any hope.
We believe that Jesus died and rose again, and so we also believe that God will bring back with Jesus his followers who have already died.
Following what the Lord himself has said, we tell you that at the Lord’s royal arrival, we who are still alive will not precede those who have died.

The Lord himself will come down from heaven shouting a command, with the voice of the chief angel, and with a blast from God’s trumpet. Then those who believed in Christ but have already died will rise first.
After that, we who are still alive and are left will be caught up together with them in the clouds to welcome the Lord in the air. And so we will be with the Lord forever.
So encourage one another with these words.

verses.heading: The Day of the Lord Is Coming / The Day of the Lord Is Coming
verses.text: Now we don’t need to write to you, brothers and sisters, about times and dates.
You know very well that the day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.
People will be saying that everything is peaceful and safe, but then they will suddenly be destroyed. It will be like birth pains suddenly coming on a pregnant woman. None of them will escape.
But you, brothers and sisters, are not in darkness, so that day shouldn’t surprise you the way a thief would.
All of you are children of the light and children of the day. We don’t belong to the night or to the darkness.
So let’s not be like the others, who are asleep. Instead, let’s be wide awake and sober.
Those who sleep, sleep at night, and those who get drunk, get drunk at night.
But since we belong to the day, let’s stay sober. Let’s put on faith and love like armor and the hope of salvation like a helmet.
God didn’t choose us to receive his anger but to receive salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.
Jesus died for us so that we might live with him, whether we are still alive on this earth or whether we have already died.
So encourage one another and build each other up, just as in fact you are doing.

verses.heading: Final Teachings / Final Teachings
verses.text: Now we ask you, brothers and sisters, to recognize the godly leaders who work hard among you, who care for you in the Lord and correct you.
Respect them in love because of what they do. Live in peace with one another.

And we urge you, brothers and sisters, to warn certain people who don’t want to work and who are being disruptive. Encourage those who have lost hope, help those who are weak, and be patient with everyone.
Make sure that no one pays back one wrong act with another. Instead, always try to do what’s good for each other and for everyone else.
Always be joyful,
never stop praying,
and give thanks no matter what happens, because this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.
Don’t stifle the Holy Spirit.
Don’t treat prophecies as if they didn’t matter,
but test them all. Hold on to what is good,
but get far away from every kind of evil.
May God himself, the God of peace, make you holy and complete. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be kept blameless from now until our Lord Jesus Christ comes.
The one who has called you is faithful, and he will do all these things.
Brothers and sisters, pray for us.
Greet all God’s people with a holy kiss.
I command you in the name of the Lord to have this letter read to all the brothers and sisters.
May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
May God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.

verses.heading: Paul Prays and Gives Thanks / Paul Prays and Gives Thanks
verses.text: We should always thank God for you, brothers and sisters. That’s only right, because your faith is growing more and more and your love for one another is increasing.
We’ve been bragging to the rest of God’s churches about your endurance and faith in all the suffering and testing you’re going through.
Your endurance is a clear sign that God judges fairly. You’ll be considered worthy of the kingdom of God for which you’re suffering.
And God will do what’s fair in the end by paying those who are troubling you back with trouble of their own,
and he’ll give relief to you who are troubled and to us as well. All this will happen when the Lord Jesus appears from heaven in blazing fire with his powerful angels.
He’ll punish those who don’t know God and who don’t obey the good news about our Lord Jesus.
They’ll be destroyed forever and be shut out of heaven, and they’ll never see the glory of the Lord’s strength.

All these things will happen when he comes to be glorified in his holy people. Everyone who has believed will be amazed when they see him. This includes you, because you have believed our testimony to you.

Keeping this in mind, we pray for you constantly. We pray that God will make you worthy of his calling and, by his power, make every good thing you want to do come true. We pray that he will make perfect everything you’ve done by faith.

We pray all this so that the name of our Lord Jesus will receive glory through what you’ve done and so that you’ll receive glory through what he has done, in keeping with the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.heading: The Man of Sin / The Man of Sin
verses.text: Regarding the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and the time when we’ll go to be with him, we ask you, brothers and sisters,

not to become easily upset or alarmed. If you receive a message that’s supposedly from us, and it says that the day of the Lord has already come, don’t get upset, whether that message is spoken or written or prophesied.
Don’t let anyone trick you in any way. That day won’t come until people rise up against God and the man of sin appears. He’s a marked man, headed for ruin.
He’ll oppose everything that’s called God or is worshiped, and he’ll give himself power over everything. He’ll set himself up in God’s temple and announce that he’s God himself.
Don’t you remember that when I was with you, I used to tell you these things?
Now you know what’s holding back the man of sin so that he will make his appearance at the right time.
The secret power of sin is already at work, but the one who’s now holding back that power will keep doing it until he’s taken out of the way.
Then the man of sin will be revealed. But the Lord Jesus will overthrow him with the breath of his mouth and destroy him with the glorious brightness of his coming.
The coming of the man of sin will fit how Satan works. He’ll show his power through all kinds of signs and wonders that will lead people astray.
People who are being lost will be fooled by this evil because they refuse to love the truth that would save them.
So God lets them be fooled completely, so that they’ll believe the false things they’ve been told.
And because they wouldn’t believe the truth but took pleasure in evil, they will be judged.

verses.heading: Remain Strong in the Faith / Remain Strong in the Faith
verses.text: But we should always thank God for you, brothers and sisters, because the Lord loves you and chose you as the first to be saved. This has happened through the work of the Holy Spirit, which makes people holy, and through your belief in the truth.
God called you to be saved through the good news that we preach, and you will share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Brothers and sisters, remain strong in the faith. Hold on to what we’ve taught you in person and in our letters.

May our Lord Jesus Christ and God our Father encourage your hearts and make you strong in every good thing that you do and say. God loved us and by his grace he has given us good hope and encouragement that will last forever.

verses.heading: Paul Asks for Prayer / Paul Asks for Prayer
verses.text: Now I want to talk about some other matters. Brothers and sisters, pray for us, that the Lord’s message will spread quickly and that others will honor it just as you have.
And pray that we will be rescued from sinful and evil people, because not everyone has faith.
But the Lord is faithful, and he will strengthen you and protect you from the evil one.
We’re confident in the Lord that you’re doing the things we’ve told you to do and that you’ll keep on doing them.
May the Lord guide your hearts into God’s love and into the strength that Christ gives.

verses.heading: Paul Warns Those Who Don’t Want to Work / Paul Warns Those Who Don’t Want to Work
verses.text: Brothers and sisters, we command you in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ to keep away from every believer who’s lazy and disruptive and who doesn’t follow the teaching you received from us.
You know how you should follow our example. We weren’t lazy when we were with you.
We didn’t eat anyone’s food without paying for it. Instead, we worked night and day, laboring away so that we wouldn’t cause any expense to any of you.
We earned our own living, even though we had the right to receive help from you, in order to set an example for you to follow.
Even when we were with you, we gave you this rule: “Anyone who won’t work shouldn’t be allowed to eat.”
We hear that some people among you are lazy and disruptive. They don’t do any work of their own, and they meddle in other people’s business.
In the Lord Jesus Christ, we command and urge people like that to settle down and earn their own living.
But you, brothers and sisters, don’t ever get tired of doing what is good.
Take special note of anyone who doesn’t obey the teachings in our letter and then don’t have anything to do with them. Then they’ll feel ashamed.
But don’t think of them as an enemy. Instead, warn them as you would warn another believer.

verses.heading: Final Greetings / Final Greetings
verses.text: May the Lord who gives peace give you peace at all times and in every way. May the Lord be with all of you.
I, Paul, write this greeting in my own handwriting. That’s how I prove that I’m the author of all my letters. I always do it that way.
May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.
From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus, as commanded by God our Savior and Christ Jesus our hope.
To Timothy, my true son in the faith. May God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord give you grace, mercy, and peace.

verses.heading: Paul Warns Timothy to Oppose False Teachers / Paul Warns Timothy to Oppose False Teachers
verses.text: As I told you when I went into Macedonia, I want you to stay there in Ephesus. I need you to command certain people not to teach things that aren’t true and not to spend their time on made-up stories
and endless ancestry lists. These things only lead to fights about ideas. They don’t help God’s work move forward. Instead, that happens by faith.
I’m commanding you to do this for the sake of love, which comes from a pure heart, a clear conscience, and sincere faith.
Some people have turned away from these things and would rather talk about things that are pointless.
They want to be teachers of the law, but they don’t know what they are talking about, even though they think they do.
We know that the law is good if it’s used in the proper way.

It isn’t made for godly people, but for lawbreakers and rebels, for ungodly and sinful people, for those who aren’t holy and who don’t believe. The law is for those who kill their fathers or mothers, for murderers,

for those who commit sexual sins and homosexual acts. It’s for people who buy and sell slaves, who lie, and who give false witness in court. And it’s for anything else that goes against the true teaching
that agrees with the good news about the glory of the blessed God. He trusted me with that good news.

verses.heading: The Lord Pours Out His Grace on Paul / The Lord Pours Out His Grace on Paul
verses.text: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord for giving me strength and for considering me faithful and appointing me to serve him.

I used to say insulting things about Jesus. I tried to hurt his followers, and I even used violence against them. But God had mercy on me because I did those things without knowing any better. I wasn’t a believer.
Our Lord poured out more and more of his grace on me, along with faith and love from Christ Jesus.
Here’s a saying you can trust and accept completely: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners. And I’m the worst sinner of all,

but for that very reason, God showed me mercy. That way Christ Jesus could show how very patient he is. I, the worst of sinners, could become an example for everyone who would believe in him and receive eternal life.
May the eternal King, who will never die, who can’t be seen, and who is the only God, receive honor and glory for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.heading: Paul Commands Timothy / Paul Commands Timothy
verses.text: Timothy, my son, I’m giving you this command in keeping with the prophecies that were once made about you. By remembering them, you’ll be able to fight the battle well
and hold on to faith and a clear conscience. Some people have rejected these things, and now their faith is like a sinking ship.
Hymenaeus and Alexander are two of those people. I’ve handed them over to Satan so that they will learn not to say insulting things about God.

verses.heading: Teachings About Worship / Teachings About Worship
verses.text: First, I want you to pray for all people. Give thanks for them and ask God to help and bless them.
Pray for kings and for everyone who is in authority, so that we can live peaceful and quiet lives. And pray that we will be godly and holy.
This is good, and it pleases God our Savior,
who wants all people to be saved and come to know the truth.
There’s only one God, and there’s only one mediator between God and human beings. That’s the man Christ Jesus,
who gave himself to pay for the sins of all people. We’ve been given this message at just the right time.
I was appointed to be a messenger and an apostle to preach the good news. (I’m telling the truth; I’m not lying.) God appointed me to be a true and faithful teacher of the Gentiles.
So I want the men in every place to pray, lifting up holy hands without anger or arguing.
In the same way, I want the women to be careful how they dress. They should wear clothes that are right and proper.
Instead of fancy hairstyles, gold, pearls, or expensive clothes, they should put on good works. This is proper for women who claim to worship God.
When a woman is learning, she should be quiet. She should follow her leaders in every way.
I don’t let women teach or take authority over men. They must be quiet.
Adam was made first, and then Eve was made.
Adam wasn’t the one who was tricked; the woman was tricked and became a sinner.
But women will be kept safe during childbirth if they keep on believing, loving, and leading a holy life in a proper way.

verses.heading: Rules for Choosing Leaders and Deacons / Rules for Choosing Leaders and Deacons
verses.text: Here’s a saying you can trust: Anyone who wants to be a leader in the church wants to do something good.

But a leader must have a good reputation. He must be faithful to his wife. He must be restrained, self-controlled, and worthy of respect. He must welcome people into his home, and he must be able to teach.
He must not get drunk or push people around; instead, he needs to be gentle. He must not be a person who likes to argue or who loves money.
He must manage his own family well and make sure that his children obey him and treat him with respect.
After all, if someone doesn’t know how to manage his own family, how can he take care of God’s church?
A leader must not be a new believer. Otherwise, he might become proud and go wrong, just as the devil did.

A leader must also have a good reputation among those who are outside the church. If it turns out that he’s done a lot of wrong things, he’ll be embarrassed, and the devil will be able to ruin his work.
In the same way, deacons must be worthy of respect. They must be honest. they must not drink too much wine, and they must not try to get money by cheating other people.
They must hold on to the deep truths of the faith with a clear conscience.
They should be tested first, and then, if there’s nothing against them, they can serve as deacons.
In the same way, the women must be worthy of respect. They shouldn’t be people who say things that hurt others. They must be restrained, and they must be worthy of trust in everything.
A deacon must be faithful to his wife. He has to be able to manage his children and family well.
If anyone serves well as a deacon, they will earn the full respect of others and strengthen their faith in Christ Jesus.

verses.heading: Paul’s Reasons for Giving Instructions to Timothy / Paul’s Reasons for Giving Instructions to Timothy
verses.text: I hope I can come to you soon. But I’m writing these instructions to you now
so that if I have to put off my visit, you’ll know how people should act in God’s family, the church of the living God, which is the pillar and foundation of the truth.

Without question, true godliness comes from this great mystery: Jesus came as a human being, and he was declared right with God by the Holy Spirit. He was seen by angels, preached among the nations, believed on in the world, and taken up in glory.
The Spirit clearly says that in later times some people will abandon the faith, follow deceptive spirits, and believe things that demons teach.
Teachings like those come from liars who are hypocrites and who have destroyed their own consciences.

They don’t allow people to get married, and they order them not to eat certain foods. But God created those foods, so people who believe and know the truth should receive them and give thanks for them.
Everything God created is good, and you shouldn’t reject any of it. Instead, you should thank God for it,
because the word of God and prayer make it holy.

If you point out these things to the brothers and sisters, you will be serving Christ Jesus well. You’ll show that you’ve been strengthened by the truths of the faith and by the good teaching you’ve obeyed.
But don’t have anything to do with foolish and ignorant stories that leave God out completely. Instead, train yourself to be godly.
Physical training has some value, but being godly has value in every way. It can help both in the life you’re now living and in the life to come.
That’s a saying you can trust.
This is why we work and try so hard—because we’ve put our hope in the living God, who’s the Savior of all people, especially of those who believe.
Command and teach these things.

Don’t let anyone look down on you because you’re a young person. Instead, set an example for the believers in what you say and in how you live, how you love, and in what you believe. Show the believers how to be pure.
Until I come, I want you to concentrate on reading Scripture publicly and on encouraging and teaching others.
Don’t fail to use the gift that the Holy Spirit gave you through a prophecy from God when the elders placed their hands on you.
Keep on doing these things. Work hard at them, and then everyone will see how you’re growing and maturing.
Be careful how you live and what you believe. If you keep doing what I’ve told you, you’ll save yourself and those who listen to you.

verses.heading: Instructions About Widows, Elders, and Slaves / Instructions About Widows, Elders, and Slaves
verses.text: If you need to correct an older man, do it respectfully. Appeal to him as if he were your father. Treat younger men as if they were your brothers,
older women as if they were your mothers, and younger women as if they were your sisters, with complete purity.
Take care of widows who actually need help.

But if a widow has children or grandchildren, these relatives should first learn to put their faith into practice and care for their own family. That way they will repay their parents and grandparents, which is something that pleases God.
A widow who truly needs help and is left all alone puts her hope in God. She keeps on praying night and day and asking God for help.
But a widow who lives for pleasure is dead even while she’s still alive.
Give these instructions to the people so that no one will do the wrong thing.
Anyone who doesn’t provide for their own relatives, and especially for their own family, has denied the faith and is worse than someone who doesn’t believe.
No widow should be put on the list of widows unless she’s more than 60 years old. She has to have been faithful to her husband,

and she must be well known for doing good things such as bringing up children, inviting guests into her home, serving the Lord’s people in humble ways, and helping those in trouble. A widow should spend her time doing all kinds of good things like these.
But don’t put younger widows on the list of those the church is supporting. They might promise to serve only Christ, but later they might have a strong desire to get married again
and break their promise. If they do that, they’ll be judged.
Besides, younger widows can get into the habit of being lazy and going around from house to house, wasting their time and bothering other people. They can talk nonsense and say things they shouldn’t.
So I encourage younger widows to get married again, have children, and take care of their own homes. That way the enemy won’t get the chance to say bad things about them.
Unfortunately, some have already turned away to follow Satan.

If a woman who’s a believer is already taking care of widows, she should continue to help them and not ask the church to care for them instead. That way the church will be able to help widows who have no other options.
Elders who lead the church well should be honored both with respect and with financial support. This is especially true of elders who preach and teach.
Scripture says, “Don’t stop an ox from eating while it helps separate the grain from the straw.” Scripture also says, “Workers are worthy of their pay.”
Don’t consider an accusation against an elder unless two or three witnesses make it.
But elders who are sinning should be corrected in front of everyone else, as a warning to the others.
I command you in the sight of God and Christ Jesus and the chosen angels to follow these instructions. Treat everyone the same and don’t favor one person over another.
Don’t be too quick to place your hands on others to set them apart to serve God. If it turns out that they’re involved in sin, it will look as if you approve. Keep yourself pure.
Stop drinking only water. If your stomach is upset, drink a little wine. That may also help the other sicknesses you often have.
The sins of some people are easy to see. They’re already being judged. Others will be judged later.
In the same way, good works are easy to see, and even good works that are hard to see won’t stay hidden forever.
Those who are being held as slaves should treat their masters as if they were worthy of full respect. That way people won’t say bad things about God’s name and about what we teach.

verses.heading: People Who Teach Lies or Love Money / People Who Teach Lies or Love Money
verses.text: Slaves whose masters are believers shouldn’t treat them with less respect just because the masters are believers. Instead, they should serve them even better. They should love their masters because they’re believers too and because they’re committed to caring for them. These are the things you are to teach and insist on.
If someone teaches something different and doesn’t agree with the healthy instruction of our Lord Jesus Christ and with godly teaching,

then that person is proud and doesn’t understand anything. They like to argue more than they should, and they’ll always be fighting about what words mean. This results in jealousy, fighting, harmful talk, and bad suspicions.
It causes trouble all the time between people whose minds are twisted by sin. They once knew the truth, but it has been taken away from them. They think they can get rich by being godly.
You do gain a lot when you live a godly life. But you have to be happy with what you have.
We didn’t bring anything into the world, and we can’t take anything out of it.
If we have food and clothing, we should be happy with those.
People who want to get rich are tempted, and they fall into a trap. They start to have many foolish and harmful desires that drag them down into ruin and destruction.
Love for money causes all kinds of evil. By trying to get rich, some people have wandered away from the faith and been hurt by many sad things that have happened to them.

verses.heading: Paul Gives a Final Command to Timothy / Paul Gives a Final Command to Timothy
verses.text: But you’re a man of God, so run away from all those things. Instead, develop righteousness, godliness, faith, love, endurance, and gentleness.
Fight the good fight of the faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called when you openly told others what you believed in front of many witnesses.
In the sight of God, who gives life to everything, and in the sight of Christ Jesus, who told the truth when he was a witness in front of Pontius Pilate, I give you a command.
Obey it without fault or failure until our Lord Jesus Christ appears.
God will bring him back at the time he has chosen. God is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and the Lord of lords.
God is the only one who can’t die. He lives in light that no one can approach. No one has seen him and no one can see him. Honor and power belong to him forever. Amen.

Command people who are rich in this world not to be proud and not to put their hope in riches, which are so uncertain. Tell them to put their hope in God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy.
Command them to do what is good and to be rich in doing good things, to give freely, and to be willing to share.
That way they will store up true riches for themselves. This will provide a firm basis for the next life so that they can take hold of the life that really is life.
Timothy, guard what God has trusted you with. Stay away from godless chatter and from the opposing ideas that are falsely called knowledge.
Some people believe them, and by doing that they’ve turned away from the faith. May God’s grace be with you all.
From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, in keeping with the promise of life that is in Christ Jesus.
To Timothy, my dear son. May God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord give you grace, mercy, and peace.

verses.heading: Paul Gives Thanks / Paul Gives Thanks
verses.text: I serve God, as did our people of long ago, with a clear conscience, and I thank God as I remember you constantly in my prayers, night and day.
I recall your tears, and I long to see you so that I can be filled with joy.
I’m reminded of your sincere faith, which was alive first in your grandmother Lois and then in your mother Eunice. I’m certain that it’s also in you now.

verses.heading: Paul Encourages Timothy to Be Faithful / Paul Encourages Timothy to Be Faithful
verses.text: That’s why I want to encourage you to fan into flame the gift that God gave you when I placed my hands on you.
The Spirit that God has given us doesn’t make us weak and fearful. Instead, the Spirit gives us power, love, and self-control.
So don’t be ashamed of the message about our Lord, and don’t be ashamed of me, his prisoner. Instead, join with me as I suffer for the good news. God’s power will help us do that.

God has saved us and called us to live a holy life. This isn’t because of anything we’ve done, but because of his own purpose and grace. This grace was given to us in Christ Jesus even before time began.
It has now been made known through the coming of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who has destroyed death and brought never-ending life out into the light through the good news.
I was appointed to be a messenger, an apostle, and a teacher of the good news.

That’s why I’m suffering the way I am. But I’m not ashamed, because I know the one I’ve believed in and I’m certain that he’s able to protect what I’ve given him. I can trust him with it until the day he returns.
Follow what you’ve heard from me as the pattern for true teaching, with faith and love in Christ Jesus.
Guard what you have been trusted with—guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit who lives in us.

verses.heading: Examples of Faithful and Unfaithful People / Examples of Faithful and Unfaithful People
verses.text: You know that all the believers in the province of Asia have deserted me, including Phygelus and Hermogenes.
May the Lord show mercy to all who live in the house of Onesiphorus. He has often encouraged me. He wasn’t ashamed of me, even though I was being held in chains.
It was just the opposite! When he was in Rome, he looked everywhere for me, and he finally found me.
May he find mercy from the Lord on the day Jesus returns as judge! You know very well how many ways he helped me in Ephesus.

verses.heading: Paul Again Encourages Timothy to Be Faithful / Paul Again Encourages Timothy to Be Faithful
verses.text: My son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
You’ve heard me teach things in front of many witnesses. Pass them on to people you can trust, and then they’ll be able to teach others also.
Like a good soldier of Christ Jesus, join with me in suffering.
A soldier doesn’t take part in things that don’t have anything to do with the army. Instead, they try to please their commanding officer.
It’s the same for anyone who takes part in a sport. They don’t receive the winner’s crown unless they play by the rules.
The farmer who works hard should be the first to receive a share of the crops.
Think about what I’m saying, and the Lord will help you understand what it all means.
Remember Jesus Christ, who was raised from the dead, and who was from David’s family line. That’s the good news I preach,
and I’m suffering for it like a criminal in these chains. But God’s word isn’t being held back by chains.
So I put up with everything for the good of God’s chosen people, so that they also can be saved through Christ Jesus, with glory that will last forever.
Here’s a saying you can trust: If we died with him, we’ll also live with him.
If we endure, we’ll also rule with him. If we say we don’t know him, he’ll say he doesn’t know us.
But even if we’re not faithful, he’ll still be faithful, because he must always be true to himself.

verses.heading: What to Do About False Teachers / What to Do About False Teachers
verses.text: Keep reminding God’s people about these things. Warn them in the presence of God not to argue about words. Those arguments don’t have any value. All they do is destroy everyone who listens to them.
Do your best to please God. Be a worker who doesn’t need to be ashamed, one who handles the message of truth correctly.
Stay away from godless chatter. Those who take part in it will become more and more ungodly.
Their teaching will spread like a deadly infection. Hymenaeus and Philetus are two of those teachers.
They’ve turned away from the truth. They’re saying the resurrection of the dead has already happened, and they’re destroying the faith of some people.
But God’s solid foundation stands firm, with this message written on it: “The Lord knows who his own people are.” Also, “All those who say that they believe in the Lord must stop doing wrong.”

In a wealthy home there are things made out of gold and silver as well as things made out of wood and clay. Some are used for special occasions like dinner parties, and others are used for the dirtier jobs.
If someone stays away from dirty things, then they’ll be available for special purposes. They’ll stand out as different, and the Master will be able to use them for anything.

So stay away from the bad things that young people often want. Try hard to do what’s right and to have faith, love, and peace. Do these things together with all those who call on the Lord from a pure heart.
But don’t have anything to do with arguing. It’s foolish. You know it only leads to fights.
Anyone who serves the Lord must not be difficult to get along with. Instead, they must be kind to everyone, able to teach, and not hold anything against anybody.
If anyone opposes them, they must correct them gently, hoping that God will give them a change of heart and lead them to know the truth.
That way they may come to their senses and escape the devil’s trap, since he has taken them as prisoners to do what he wants.
But I want you to know that there will be terrible times in the last days.
People will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, braggers, proud, abusive, and disobedient to their parents. They won’t be thankful or holy,
and they won’t love or forgive others. They’ll tell lies about other people. They won’t have any self-control, so they’ll be wild, hate what is good,
turn against their friends, and act without thinking. They’ll believe they’re better than others, and they’ll love pleasure instead of loving God.
They’ll pretend that they’re serving God, but they won’t believe that God has any power. Don’t have anything to do with people like that.

They’re the kind of people who take advantage of vulnerable women. They get into their homes and get control over them. These women are already struggling with wrong behaviors they can’t stop giving in to.
They’re always studying, but they’re never able to understand the truth.
Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, these teachers oppose the truth. Their minds are twisted, so what they say about the faith can’t be trusted.
But they won’t get very far, because just like Jannes and Jambres, their foolishness will become clear to everyone.

verses.heading: Paul Gives a Final Command to Timothy / Paul Gives a Final Command to Timothy
verses.text: But you know all about my teaching, my way of life, and my purpose, faith, love, and endurance.

You know that I’ve been treated badly and suffered greatly. You know what kinds of things happened to me in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra—how badly I was treated there. But the Lord saved me from all my troubles.
In fact, everyone who wants to live a godly life in Christ Jesus will be treated badly,
while evil people and impostors will go from bad to worse. They’ll deceive others and others will deceive them.
But I want you to continue to follow what you’ve learned and have become convinced of, because you know the people you learned it from.
You’ve known the Holy Scriptures ever since you were a little child. They’re able to teach you how to be saved through faith in Christ Jesus.
God has breathed life into all Scripture. It’s useful for teaching, challenging, correcting, and training people to do what’s right,
so that the servant of God will be completely prepared to do everything good.
In the presence of God and of Christ Jesus, who will judge the living and the dead, and because he and his kingdom are coming, I’m giving you these instructions:

Preach the word, be ready to serve God in good times and bad, correct people’s mistakes. Warn them, encourage them with words of hope, and be very patient as you do these things. Teach the people carefully,

because the time will come when they won’t put up with good teaching. Instead, they’ll try to satisfy their own desires. They’ll gather a large number of teachers around them who will tell them what they want to hear.
The people will stop listening to the truth and they’ll turn to stories that aren’t true.
But as for you, stay in control of yourself no matter what happens. Don’t give up when things become difficult. Work to spread the good news. Fulfill all the responsibilities of your work.
I’m already being poured out like a drink offering. It will soon be time for me to leave.
I’ve fought the good fight, I’ve finished the race, I’ve kept the faith.

Now there’s a crown waiting for me, the crown that’s given to those who are right with God. The Lord, who judges fairly, will give it to me on the day he returns, and not only to me, but also to all those who are longing for him to return.

verses.heading: Personal Words / Personal Words
verses.text: Do your best to come to me quickly.
