verses.text: Since Christ suffered in his body, protect yourselves by having the same attitude that he did, because anyone who suffers in their body is finished with sin.
As a result, they don’t live the rest of their earthly life following wrong human desires. Instead, they live to do what God wants.

You’ve spent enough time in the past doing what ungodly people choose to do. You lived a wild life and wanted the wrong things. You got drunk and went to wild parties. You worshiped statues of gods, which is something the Lord hates.
Ungodly people are surprised that you don’t join them anymore in their wild and wasteful living, and they insult you because you don’t.
But they’ll have to explain their actions to God, who’s ready to judge the living and the dead.

That’s why the good news was preached even to people who are now dead. Even though they were judged in their bodies for what they did while they lived on earth, they were told the good news so that they could live in the spirit the way God wants.
The end of all things is near. So be alert and stay sober so that you can pray.
Most of all, love one another deeply, because love covers over many sins.
Entertain others in your homes without complaining.
Each of you has received a gift that you can use to serve others. You should use it as something that God has trusted you with. These gifts come in many forms.

If anyone speaks, they should do it as someone who’s speaking God’s own words. If anyone serves, they should do it with the strength that God provides. That way God will be praised in all things through Jesus Christ. May he receive the glory and power for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.heading: Suffering for Being a Christian / Suffering for Being a Christian
verses.text: Dear friends, don’t be surprised if you get the feeling that you’re being tested by fire. Don’t think that something strange is happening to you.
Instead, be glad that you can take part in Christ’s sufferings. That way you’ll be overjoyed when his glory is revealed.
If people insult you because of the name of Christ, then you’re blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.
If you suffer, it shouldn’t be because you’re a murderer or a thief or any other kind of criminal. It shouldn’t be because you interfere in other people’s business.
But if you suffer because you’re a Christian, then don’t be ashamed. Instead, praise God that you’re known by the name of Christ.
It’s time for judgment to begin with God’s household. And if it begins with us, what will happen to people who don’t obey the good news of God?
Scripture says, “If it’s hard for people who are living right to be saved, then what will happen to ungodly people and sinners?”
Here’s what people who suffer according to God’s will should do. They should commit themselves to their faithful Creator and continue to do good.

verses.heading: To Older and Younger Believers / To Older and Younger Believers
verses.text: I want to appeal to the elders among you as someone who’s an elder himself. I also appeal to you as a witness of Christ’s sufferings and as someone who will share in the glory that’s going to be revealed.

Be shepherds of God’s flock that is under your care. Watch over them, not because you have to, but because you want to. That’s what God wants you to do. Don’t do it to try to get money in dishonest ways, but because you really want to serve.
Don’t act like dictators towards those who are under your care. Instead, be good examples to the flock.
When the Chief Shepherd returns, you’ll receive the crown of glory that will never fade away.

In the same way, you who are younger should follow the lead of your elders. All of you should have a humble attitude toward one another, because Scripture says, “God opposes those who are proud, but he gives grace to those who are humble.”
So humble yourselves under God’s mighty hand, and then he will honor you at the right time.
Turn all your worries over to him, because he cares about you.
Be alert and stay sober. Your enemy the devil is prowling around like a roaring lion looking for something to kill and eat.
Fight back against him, standing firm in the faith, because you know that the family of believers throughout the world is going through the same kind of suffering.
After you’ve suffered for a little while, the God of all grace will restore you and make you strong, firm, and steadfast. He has called you to share in his eternal glory in Christ.
May he receive the power for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.heading: Final Greetings / Final Greetings
verses.text: With the help of Silas, who I consider to be a faithful brother, I’ve written you this short letter to encourage you and to confirm that this is the true grace of God. Remain strong in it.
The one who is in Babylon, who is chosen together with you, sends her greetings. Mark, my son in the faith, also sends you his greetings.
Greet one other with a kiss of friendship. Peace be to all of you who are in Christ.
From Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ. To you who have received a faith as precious as ours and who have been made right with our God and Savior Jesus Christ.
May more and more grace and peace be yours as you come to know God and Jesus our Lord.

verses.heading: Showing That God Has Called You / Showing That God Has Called You
verses.text: God’s power has given us everything we need to lead a godly life. We have come to know the God who called us by his own glory and goodness.
He has given us his very great and precious promises so that you can share in his nature. You have escaped from the corruption that’s in the world because of wrong desires.
So make every effort to add goodness to your faith. Then to goodness, add knowledge.
To knowledge, add self-control. To self-control, add endurance. To endurance, add godliness.
To godliness, add kindness. And to kindness, add love.
If you take on these qualities more and more, they’ll make you useful and fruitful as you come to know our Lord Jesus Christ.
But anyone who doesn’t take on these qualities is seeing only the present. They’re blind to the past, forgetting all their sins that have been washed away.
My brothers and sisters, make every effort to show that God has called you to be saved. If you do everything I’ve just said, you’ll never trip and fall.
You’ll receive a rich welcome into the kingdom our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. His kingdom will last forever.

verses.heading: How We Can Be Sure About Jesus / How We Can Be Sure About Jesus
verses.text: So I will always remind you of these things, even though you know them and you’re well established in the truth that you now have.
I think it’s right for me to remind you for as long as I live in this tent, that is, my body.
I know that I’ll soon be leaving it, because our Lord Jesus Christ has made that clear to me.
I hope you’ll always be able to remember these things after I’m gone. I’ll try very hard to see that you do.
When we told you about the time our Lord Jesus Christ came with power, we weren’t trying to fool you by making up stories. We saw him in all his majesty with our own eyes.
God the Father gave him honor and glory when the voice of the Majestic Glory came to him and said, “This is my beloved Son. I’m very pleased with him.”
When we were with him on the sacred mountain, we heard this voice ourselves as it came from heaven.

We can also rely completely on the message of the prophets. It’s important for you to pay attention to it. That message is like a light shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts.
Above all, here’s what you must understand. No prophecy in Scripture ever came from a prophet’s own interpretation of things.
It never came simply because a prophet wanted it to. Instead, the Holy Spirit guided the prophets as they spoke. Although the prophets were human, what they said came from God.

verses.heading: False Teachers Will Be Destroyed / False Teachers Will Be Destroyed
verses.text: But there were also false prophets among the people. In the same way, there will be false teachers among you. They’ll secretly bring in wrong teachings that can destroy you. They’ll even deny the Lord and Master who died to pay for their sins. So they will quickly destroy themselves.
But many people will do the same wrong things that the false teachers do, and this will cause people to think badly about the way of truth.
These teachers will be so greedy that they’ll make up stories to take advantage of you. But they’ve been under a sentence of death for a long time. Their destruction has not been sleeping.
God didn’t spare the angels when they sinned. Instead, he sent them to hell and chained them up in dark prisons. He’s holding them there until the day of judgment.
God didn’t spare the world’s ungodly people long ago. He brought the flood on them. But Noah preached about the right way to live, and God kept him safe along with seven other people.
God judged the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah. He burned them to ashes to make them an example of what’s going to happen to ungodly people. But
God saved Lot, a man who did what was right. Lot was shocked by the evil conduct of those people who didn’t obey God’s laws.
That good man lived among them day after day, and he saw and heard the evil things they were doing as they broke God’s laws. Lot’s godly spirit was deeply troubled.

Since all of this is true, then the Lord knows how to save godly people and keep them safe in times of testing. But he also knows how to keep ungodly people under guard until the day they will be judged and punished.

Most of all, this is true of people who are corrupted by their wrong desires and hate to be under authority. People like that are cocky and arrogant. They’re not afraid even to insult heavenly beings.
Now angels are stronger and more powerful than these people, but even angels don’t insult heavenly beings when they bring judgment on them from the Lord.

But these people say insulting things even when they don’t know what they’re talking about. They’re like wild animals that can’t think and just live by instinct, that are born only to be caught and destroyed. These people will die like animals too.

They’ll be paid back with harm for all the harm they’ve done. Their idea of a good time is a wild party in the middle of the day. They’re like dirty spots and stains. They enjoy their sinful pleasures even while they’re eating with you.

They stare at women who are not their wives and want to sleep with them. They never stop sinning. They trap people who aren’t firm in their faith. They’re experts in being greedy. But they’re under a curse.
They’ve left God’s way and wandered off. They follow the way of Balaam, son of Beor, who did wrong just to get money.
But a donkey corrected him for what he was doing. Animals can’t speak, but in this case a donkey spoke with a human voice to stop the prophet from doing something crazy.
These people are like springs without water and mists driven by a storm. The blackest darkness is reserved for them.
They speak empty, bragging words. By appealing to lust and desire, they tempt new believers who are just escaping from others who are living wrong.
They promise to give them freedom, but they themselves are slaves to depravity. That’s because “people are slaves to anything that controls them.”

They may have escaped from the corruption of the world, and they may have come to know our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. But if they get tangled up again in sin, and it becomes their master, then they’re worse off at the end than they were at the beginning.
It would have been better for them not to know the way of godliness than to know it but then turn their backs on the sacred command that was passed on to them.
What the proverbs say is true about them: “A dog returns to where it has thrown up” and “a pig that is washed goes back to rolling in the mud.”

verses.heading: The Day of the Lord / The Day of the Lord
verses.text: Dear friends, this is now my second letter to you. I’ve written both of them as reminders. I want to encourage you to think in a pure way.
I want you to remember the words that the holy prophets spoke in the past and the command our Lord and Savior gave through your apostles.
Above all, you must understand that in the last days people will laugh at the truth and follow their own wrong desires.
They’ll say, “Where is this ‘return’ he promised? Ever since our ancestors died, everything has been going on in the same way it has since the beginning of creation.”
They will deliberately forget that long ago, God’s word brought the heavens into being and his word separated the earth from the waters.
Those waters flooded the world of that time and destroyed it.
By that same word, the heavens and earth of today are being reserved for fire. They’re being kept ready for the day of judgment, when ungodly people will be destroyed.
But don’t forget this one thing, dear friends: With the Lord a day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like a day.

The Lord isn’t slow to keep his promise, not slow in the way some people understand it. Instead, he’s being patient with you. He doesn’t want anyone to be destroyed. He wants everyone to turn away from their sins.

But the day of the Lord will come like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a roar, the elements will be destroyed by fire, and the earth and everything done in it will be seen for what they really are.
Since everything will be destroyed in this way, what kind of people should you be? You should lead holy and godly lives
as you look forward to the day of God and help it come more quickly. On that day fire will destroy the heavens, and the elements will melt in the heat.
But in keeping with God’s promise, we’re looking forward to a new heaven and a new earth, where righteousness lives.
Dear friends, since you’re looking forward to this, try your best to be found pure, blameless, and at peace with God.
Remember that while our Lord is waiting patiently to return, people are being saved. Our dear brother Paul also wrote to you about this with the wisdom that God gave him.

Paul writes the same way in all his letters. He speaks about the same things I’ve just told you. His letters include some things that are hard to understand. People who are unstable and ignorant twist what he says, just as they twist the other Scriptures. But this will lead to their own destruction.
But you, dear friends, have already been warned about this. So be on your guard. Otherwise, people who don’t obey the law might lead you astray, and you’ll lose your secure position.
So grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. May he receive glory both now and forever. Amen.

verses.heading: The Word of Life Became a Human Being / The Word of Life Became a Human Being
verses.text: The Word of life was here from the beginning. We’ve heard him, we’ve seen him with our eyes, we’ve looked at him, and our hands have touched him. So we want to tell you about him.
This life has appeared, and we’ve seen him and are witnesses about him. So we’re announcing to you this same eternal life, which was with the Father and has now appeared to us.
We’re announcing to you what we’ve seen and heard so that you can share life together with us, with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.
We’re writing this to make our joy complete.

verses.heading: Walking in the Light / Walking in the Light
verses.text: Here’s the message that we’ve heard from him and are announcing to you: God is light, and there’s no darkness in him at all.
If we say that we share life with God but still walk in the darkness, then we’re lying and not living the truth.
But if we walk in the light, just as he is in the light, then we share life with one another, and the blood of Jesus his Son makes us pure from all sin.
If we claim not to have any sin, then we’re fooling ourselves and the truth isn’t in us.
But if we confess our sins, God is trustworthy and fair. He’ll forgive our sins and make us pure from every wrong thing we’ve done.
If we claim that we haven’t sinned, we’re calling God a liar and his word isn’t in us.
My dear children, I’m writing this to you so that you may not sin. But if anyone does sin, then we have a friend who speaks to the Father for us. He’s Jesus Christ, the Blameless One
who gave his life to pay for our sins. In fact, he not only paid for our sins, he also paid for the sins of the whole world.

verses.heading: Instructions About Loving and Hating Other Believers / Instructions About Loving and Hating Other Believers
verses.text: We know that we’ve come to know God if we obey his commands.
If anyone says, “I know him,” but they don’t do what God commands, then they’re a liar and they’re not telling the truth.
But if anyone does obey God’s word, then that person truly loves God. This is how we know we belong to him:
Anyone who claims to belong to him must live just as Jesus did.
Dear friends, I’m not writing you a new command. Instead, I’m writing one that you’ve heard before. You’ve had it since the beginning.

But in a sense, I am writing you a new command. Its truth was shown in the way Jesus lived, and it’s also shown in the way you’re living. That’s because the darkness is passing away, and the true light is already shining.
If someone claims to be in the light, but they hate a brother or sister, then they’re really still in the darkness.
Anyone who loves their brother and sister lives in the light. There’s nothing in them that will make them fall into sin.
But anyone who hates a brother or sister is in the darkness. They’re walking around in the darkness, and they don’t know where they’re going, because the darkness has made them blind.

verses.heading: Reasons for Writing / Reasons for Writing
verses.text: Dear children, I’m writing to you because your sins have been forgiven in Jesus’ name.
Fathers, I’m writing to you because you know the one who is from the beginning. Young men, I’m writing to you because you’ve won the battle over the evil one.

Dear children, I’m writing to you because you know the Father. Fathers, I’m writing to you because you know the one who is from the beginning. Young men, I’m writing to you because you’re strong. God’s word lives in you, and you’ve won the battle over the evil one.

verses.heading: Don’t Love the World / Don’t Love the World
verses.text: Don’t love the world or anything that’s in it. If anyone loves the world, they don’t have any love for the Father in them.

Here’s what people who belong to this world do. They try to satisfy what their wrong desires want. They long for what their sinful eyes look at. They take pride in what they have and what they do. All of this comes from the world. None of it comes from the Father.
The world and its evil desires are passing away, but whoever does the will of God lives forever.

verses.heading: Warnings About Saying No to the Son / Warnings About Saying No to the Son
verses.text: Dear children, we’re living in the last days. You’ve heard that the great enemy of Christ is coming, and even now many enemies of Christ have already come. That’s how we know that these are the last days.

These enemies left our community of believers, but they didn’t really belong to us. If they had belonged to us, they would have stayed with us. By leaving, they showed that none of them really belonged to us.
But the Holy One has made the Spirit flow all over you, just as if you’d had sacred oil poured on your head, and so all of you know the truth.
I’m not writing to you because you don’t know the truth. I’m writing because you do know it and because no lie comes from the truth.
Who is the liar? It’s anyone who says that Jesus isn’t the Christ. Any person who says this is the great enemy of Christ.
They’re denying both the Father and the Son. No one who denies the Son has the Father. But whoever accepts the Son has the Father too.
Make sure that what you’ve heard from the beginning remains in you. If it does, then you’ll remain in the Son and in the Father.
And this is what God has promised us: eternal life.
I’m writing these things to warn you about people who are trying to lead you astray.

But you have the Holy Spirit flowing over you, and the Spirit continues to live in you. So you don’t need anyone to teach you. The Spirit teaches you about everything, and his presence in you is real, not fake. So remain in Christ, just as you’ve been taught.

verses.heading: God’s Children and Sin / God’s Children and Sin
verses.text: And now, dear children, continue in him, so that when he appears, we can be confident and not ashamed to meet him when he comes.
You know that God always does what is right, so you also know that everyone who does what is right is God’s child.
See what great love the Father has given us: We’re even called children of God! And that’s what we really are. The world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.
Dear friends, now we are children of God. We don’t know yet what we will be. But we know that when Christ appears, we’ll be like him, because we’ll see him as he really is.
All who hope to be like him make themselves pure the way Christ is pure.
Everyone who sins breaks the law. In fact, sin is breaking the law.
But you know that Christ came to take our sins away. And there is no sin in him.
No one who lives in him keeps on sinning, but no one who keeps on sinning has seen him or known him.
Dear children, don’t let anyone lead you astray. The person who does what is right is holy, just as Christ is holy.
The person who does what is sinful belongs to the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the beginning. But the Son of God came to destroy the devil’s work.
No one who is God’s child will keep on sinning, because God’s life is growing inside them. They can’t go on sinning, because they’re God’s children.

Here’s how you can tell the difference between God’s children and the devil’s children. Anyone who doesn’t do what is right isn’t God’s child, and anyone who doesn’t love their brother or sister isn’t God’s child either.

verses.heading: More Instructions About Loving and Hating One Another / More Instructions About Loving and Hating One Another
verses.text: We’ve heard from the beginning that we should love one another.
Don’t be like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and murdered his brother. And why did he murder him? Because the things he did were wrong, and the things his brother did were right.
My brothers and sisters, don’t be surprised if the world hates you.
We know that we’ve passed from death into life, because we love one another. Anyone who doesn’t love remains in death.
Anyone who hates their brother or sister is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life.
This is how we know what love is: Jesus Christ gave his life for us. So we should give our own lives for our brothers and sisters.
If anyone sees a brother or sister in need and they have the means to help them, but they don’t care about them enough to do anything, how can the love of God be in that person?
Dear children, let’s not love just with words or talk. Let’s really love, by doing something.
This is how we know that we belong to the truth; it’s how we find peace in our hearts when we’re with God.
If we feel guilty in our hearts, we know that God is greater than our hearts, and he knows everything.
Dear friends, if we don’t feel guilty in our hearts, we can be confident when we pray,
and God will give us anything we ask for. That’s because we obey his commands and do what pleases him.
And this is his command: to believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and to love one another as he commanded us.
The one who obeys God’s commands lives in him, and he lives in them. Here’s how we know that God lives in us: We know it by the Holy Spirit he gave us.

verses.heading: Jesus Came as a Human Being / Jesus Came as a Human Being
verses.text: Dear friends, don’t believe every spirit. Instead, test the spirits to see if they are from God. Many false prophets have gone out into the world.
Here’s how you can recognize the Spirit of God: Every spirit that agrees that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God.
But every spirit that doesn’t agree with this isn’t from God. Instead, it’s the spirit of the great enemy of Christ. You’ve heard that this spirit is coming, and even now it’s already in the world.
But you, dear children, are from God, and you have defeated these enemies. That’s because the one who’s in you is greater than the one who’s in the world.
False prophets are from world, and so they speak from the world’s point of view, and the world listens to them.

But we are from God, and whoever knows God listen to us. But whoever isn’t from God doesn’t listen to us. That’s how we can tell the difference between the Spirit of truth and the spirit of falseness.

verses.heading: We Love Because God Loved Us / We Love Because God Loved Us
verses.text: Dear friends, let us love one another, because love comes from God. Everyone who loves is a child of God and knows God.
Anyone who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, because God is love.
This is how God showed his love among us: He sent his only Son into the world so that we could receive life through him.
This is love: not that we loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son to give his life to purify us from our sins.
Dear friends, since God loved us that much, we should also love one another.
No one has ever seen God, but if we love one another, God lives in us, and his love is made complete in us.
Here’s how we know that we live in him and he lives in us: He has given us his Holy Spirit.
The Father sent his Son to be the Savior of the world. We have seen this and are witnesses to it.
If anyone agrees that Jesus is the Son of God, God lives in them and they live in God.
And so we know and depend on the love that God has for us. God is love. Whoever lives in love lives in God, and God lives in them.
This is how love is made complete among us so that we will have confidence on the day of judgment: In this world we are like Jesus.
There is no fear in love. Instead, perfect love drives away fear, because fear has to do with being punished. The one who fears has not been perfected in love.
We love because he loved us first.

If anyone claims to love God but they hate a brother or sister, they’re a liar. If they don’t love their brother or sister, even though they’ve seen them, they can’t claim to love God, when they haven’t seen him.
Here’s the command God has given us: Anyone who loves God must also love their brother and sister.

verses.heading: Faith in God’s Son Who Became a Human Being / Faith in God’s Son Who Became a Human Being
verses.text: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ is a child of God. And everyone who loves the Father loves his child as well.
Here’s how we know that we love God’s children: by loving God and obeying his commands.
In fact, this is what it means to love God: to obey his commands. And his commands aren’t hard to obey,
because everyone who’s a child of God has won the battle over the world. Our faith has won the battle for us.
Who is it that has won the battle over the world? Only the person who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.
This is the one who came by water and blood—Jesus Christ. He didn’t come by water only, but by water and blood. The Spirit is a truthful witness about this, because the Spirit is the truth.
So there are three witnesses about Jesus:
the Spirit, the water, and the blood. And the three of them agree.
We accept what humans say when they’re witnesses. But when God is a witness, what he says is much stronger evidence, because it’s God talking, and he’s talking about his own Son.
Whoever believes in the Son of God accepts what God says about him. Whoever doesn’t believe what God says is calling him a liar by not believing what God has said about his Son.
And this is what God is saying: He has given us eternal life, and this life is found in his Son.
Whoever has the Son has life. Whoever doesn’t have the Son of God doesn’t have life.

verses.heading: Final Words / Final Words
verses.text: I’m writing these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God so that you’ll know you have eternal life.
When we pray to God, we can be confident of this: If we ask anything according to his will, he hears us.
And if we know that God hears us, we know that we have whatever we ask for.

If you see any brother or sister commit a sin that doesn’t lead to death, then you should pray for them, and God will give them life. I’m talking about someone whose sin doesn’t lead to death. There is a sin that does lead to death. I’m not saying you should pray about that.
Doing wrong is always sin, but there are sins that don’t lead to death.
We know that anyone who is God’s child will not sin continually. The Son of God keeps them safe, and the evil one can’t harm them.
We know that we are children of God and that the whole world is under the control of the evil one.

We also know that the Son of God has come and given us understanding so that we can know the God who is true. And we are in the true God by being in his Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.
Dear children, keep yourselves away from idols.
From the elder. To the lady, who has been chosen by God, and to her children. I love all of you in the truth, and I’m not the only one who loves you. So does everyone who knows the truth.
We love you because of the truth that lives in us and will be with us forever.
May God the Father and Jesus Christ his Son give us grace, mercy, and peace in truth and love.
It made me very happy to find some of your children living by the truth, just as the Father commanded us.
And now, dear lady, I’m not writing you a new command. I’m writing one we’ve had from the beginning. I’m asking that we love one another.
The way we show our love is by obeying God’s commands. As you’ve heard from the beginning, his command is that you walk in love.
I say this because many people have gone out into the world to try to deceive others. They don’t agree that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. These people are like the great enemy of Christ.
Make sure you don’t lose what we’ve worked for, but make sure you get your full reward.
If anyone leaves the teaching of Christ behind and doesn’t remain in it, that person doesn’t have God. But whoever remains in the teaching about Christ has both the Father and the Son.
If anyone comes to you and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t let them stay in your home. Don’t even say hello to them.
Anyone who welcomes them shares in their evil work.
I have a lot to write to you, but I don’t want to use paper and ink. Instead, I hope to visit you so we can talk face to face. That will make our joy complete.
The children of your sister, who is chosen by God, send their greetings.
From the elder. To my dear friend Gaius, whom I love truly.
Dear friend, I pray that you may enjoy good health and that all may go well with you, just as everything is going well with your soul.
It made me very happy when some believers came and told me that you’re faithful to the truth and that you’re walking in it.
Nothing makes me happier than to hear that my children are walking in the truth.
Dear friend, you’re faithful in what you’re doing for the brothers and sisters, even though they’re strangers to you.
They’ve told the church about your love. Please help them by sending them on their way in a manner that honors God.
They started on their journey for the sake of the Name, and they wouldn’t accept any help from those who weren’t believers.
We should let people like them stay in our homes. When we do, we’re working together with them for the truth.
I wrote to the church, but Diotrephes, who loves to be the first in everything, wouldn’t acknowledge me.

So when I come, I’ll show everyone what he’s doing. He’s saying malicious things about us that aren’t true. And as if that weren’t bad enough, he’s also refusing to welcome other believers, and he’s keeping others from doing so. In fact, if anyone does welcome them, he’s throwing them out of the church.
Dear friend, don’t imitate those who are doing wrong, but those who are doing good. Anyone who does what’s good belongs to God. Anyone who does what’s wrong hasn’t really seen or known God.
Demetrius has a good reputation with everyone, and even with the truth itself. We can also vouch for him personally, and you know you can trust our word.
I have a lot to write to you, but I don’t want to write with pen and ink.
Instead, I hope to see you soon so we can talk face to face.
May you have peace. The friends here send their greetings. Greet each one of the friends there by name.
From Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and a brother of James. To those who are called, loved by God the Father, and kept safe for Jesus Christ.
May you have great mercy, peace and love.

verses.heading: A Warning Against the Sin of Ungodly People / A Warning Against the Sin of Ungodly People
verses.text: Dear friends, I was very eager to write to you about the salvation we share. But I felt that I had to write and urge you to stand up for the faith that God’s holy people have been trusted with once and for all time.

Certain people have secretly slipped in among you. Long ago it was written that they would be found guilty. They’re ungodly people who misuse the grace of our God as an excuse for sexual sins. They deny Jesus Christ, our only Lord and King.
I want to remind you about some things you already know. The Lord saved his people when he brought them out of Egypt. But later he destroyed those who didn’t believe.
Some of the angels abandoned their positions of authority and didn’t stay where they belonged. The Lord is keeping those angels in darkness, bound with chains that last forever, until judgment day.
The people of Sodom and Gomorrah and the towns around them did immoral and unnatural things. Those people are an example of those who are punished with fire that never goes out.
In the very same way, these ungodly people act on their dreams and make their own bodies impure. They reject authority and say insulting things about heavenly beings.
But even Michael, the leader of the angels, didn’t dare to say anything insulting about the devil. They were arguing about who would get the body of Moses. Michael just said, “May the Lord stop you!”

But these people say insulting things about whatever they don’t understand. And the only things they do understand will destroy them. They’re like wild animals who can’t think for themselves and live only by instinct.

Woe to them! They’ve followed the way of Cain. Because they love money, they’ve rushed into the same mistake Balaam made. They’ve rebelled just like Korah, and they’re going to be destroyed just as he was.

These ungodly people are like stains at the meals you share. They’re shepherds who shamelessly feed only themselves. They’re like clouds without rain, blown along by the wind. They’re like trees that haven’t produced any fruit by the fall and are pulled out of the ground. That makes them dead in two ways.
They’re like wild waves of the sea—their shame rises up like foam. They’re like stars that don’t stay in place. God has reserved very great darkness for them forever.
Enoch, the seventh man in the family line of Adam, gave a prophecy about these people. He said, “Look! The Lord is coming with thousands and thousands of his holy ones.
He’s coming to judge everyone. He will find them guilty for all the ungodly acts that they’ve done in ungodly ways and for all the defiant things they’ve said against him.”
These people follow their own evil desires. They grumble and complain about others, but they brag about themselves and praise others to get what they want.

verses.heading: Remain in God’s Love / Remain in God’s Love
verses.text: Dear friends, remember what the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ said would happen.
They told you, “In the last days, some people will mock the truth. They’ll follow their own ungodly desires.”
These are the people who create divisions among you. They live only by instinct and they’re not led by the Holy Spirit.
But you, dear friends, build yourselves up in your most holy faith. Let the Holy Spirit guide you when you pray.
Keep yourselves in God’s love as you wait for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to bring you eternal life.
Show mercy to those who doubt.
Save some by pulling them out of the fire. To others, show mercy mixed with fear of sin. Hate even the clothes that are stained by the sins of those who wear them.

verses.heading: Praise to God / Praise to God
verses.text: Now God is able to keep you from falling and bring you with great joy into his heavenly glory without any fault.
So may the only God, our Savior, receive glory, majesty, power, and authority through Jesus Christ our Lord—before all time, now, and forever! Amen.

verses.heading: Introduction / Introduction
verses.text: The revelation from Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show his servants what must happen soon. God made it known by sending his angel to his servant John.
This is a record of everything he saw, that is, the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ.
Blessed is the one who reads the words of this prophecy out loud, and blessed are those who hear it and take to heart everything it says. The time when these things will come true is drawing near.

verses.heading: Greetings and Praise to God / Greetings and Praise to God
verses.text: From John. To the seven churches in the province of Asia. May you receive grace and peace from the one who is, and who was, and who is to come; from the seven spirits that are in front of God’s throne;
and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the first to rise from the dead, the ruler over the kings of the earth. Jesus loves us and has set us free from our sins by his blood.
He has made us members of his royal family and priests who serve his God and Father. May he receive glory and power for ever and ever! Amen.
“Look! He’s coming with the clouds!” “Every eye will see him, even those who pierced him.” All the nations of the earth “will mourn because of him.” This will happen! Amen.
“I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God. “I am the God who is, and who was, and who is to come, the Almighty.”

verses.heading: John’s Vision of Christ / John’s Vision of Christ
verses.text: I, John, am your brother and your partner in the suffering, the kingdom, and the patient endurance of Jesus. I was on the island of Patmos because of God’s word and the testimony of Jesus.
I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s Day, and I heard a loud voice behind me that sounded like a trumpet.
The voice said, “Write what you see on a scroll and send it to the seven churches in Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”
I turned around to see who was speaking to me. When I turned, I saw seven golden lampstands,
and in the middle of them I saw someone who looked “like a son of man.” He was dressed in a long robe and he had a gold strip of cloth around his chest.
The hair on his head was white like wool, as white as snow. His eyes were like a blazing fire,
his feet were like bronze metal glowing in a furnace, and his voice sounded like rushing waters.
He held seven stars in his right hand. A sharp sword with two edges was coming out of his mouth. His face was like the sun shining in all its brightness.
When I saw him, I fell at his feet as if I were dead. But he put his right hand on me and said, “Don’t be afraid. I’m the First and the Last,
the Living One. I was dead, but now look! I’m alive for ever and ever! And I hold the keys to death and Hades.
“Write down what you’ve seen, what is, and what’s going to happen after this.

The seven stars you saw in my right hand have a hidden meaning, and so do the seven golden lampstands. The stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the lampstands you saw are the seven churches.

verses.heading: The Letter to the Church in Ephesus / The Letter to the Church in Ephesus
verses.text: “Write this to the angel of the church in Ephesus: These are the words of the one who holds the seven stars in his right hand and walks among the seven golden lampstands.

‘I know what you’ve been doing, how you’ve been working long and hard. I that know you don’t tolerate evil people. You’ve tested those who claim to be apostles but aren’t, and you’ve discovered that they’re fakes.
You’ve been faithful and you’ve endured a lot of trouble because of me. You haven’t given up.
‘But I hold you responsible for this: You’ve lost the love you had at first.
Think about how far you’ve fallen! Realize how you’ve gone wrong, and go back to the things you were doing at first. If you don’t, I’ll come and take your lampstand away.
But you do have this in your favor: You hate what the Nicolaitans are doing, just as I hate it.
‘Whoever has ears should listen to what the Spirit is saying to the churches. If anyone wins the victory, I’ll let them to eat from the tree of life that’s in God’s paradise.’

verses.heading: The Letter to the Church in Smyrna / The Letter to the Church in Smyrna
verses.text: “Write this to the angel of the church in Smyrna: These are the words of the one who’s the First and the Last, who died and came to life again.
‘I know that you’re suffering and that you’re poor—but you’re rich! I know how you’re being insulted by people who claim to be Jews but aren’t. They’re a synagogue of Satan.

Don’t be afraid of what you’re going to suffer. I tell you, the devil will put some of you in prison to test you, and you’ll be mistreated for ten days. Be faithful, even if you have to die, and I’ll give you life as your victory crown.
‘Whoever has ears should listen to what the Spirit is saying to the churches. If anyone wins the victory, I won’t let that person be hurt at all by the second death.’

verses.heading: The Letter to the Church in Pergamum / The Letter to the Church in Pergamum
verses.text: “Write this to the angel of the church in Pergamum: These are the words of the one who has the sharp sword that has two edges.

‘I know that even though you live where Satan has his throne, you’re still faithful to me. You didn’t give up your faith even in the days of Antipas, my faithful witness, who was put to death in your city, where Satan lives.

‘But I hold you responsible for a few things. Some of you are following the teaching of Balaam, who showed Balak how to lead the people of Israel into sin. They ate food offered to idols and they committed sexual sins.
You also have people who are following the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
So turn away from your sins! If you don’t, I’ll come to you soon and fight against those people with the sword that comes out of my mouth.

‘Whoever has ears should listen to what the Spirit is saying to the churches. If anyone wins the victory, I’ll give that person some of the hidden manna. I’ll also give each of them a white stone with a new name written on it. Only the one who receives this name will know what it is.’

verses.heading: The Letter to the Church in Thyatira / The Letter to the Church in Thyatira
verses.text: “Write this to the angel of the church in Thyatira: These are the words of the Son of God, whose eyes are like blazing fire and whose feet are like polished bronze.
‘I know what you’ve been doing. I know about your love and your faith. I know how well you’ve served me and that you haven’t given up easily. In fact, you’re doing more now than you did at first.

‘But I hold you responsible for this. You’re tolerating that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophet. She has led my servants into sexual sin by her teaching and she has tricked them into eating food offered to idols.
I’ve given her time to turn away from her sinful ways, but she refuses.

Since she’s always encouraging people to “go to bed” with others, she’s going to “go to bed” herself: She’ll be sick in bed for a long time. Those who’ve been committing adultery with her will suffer greatly too, unless they turn away from what she has taught them to do.
I will strike her children dead. Then all the churches will know that I’m the one who searches hearts and minds and that I pay each person back for what they’ve done.
‘The rest of you in Thyatira haven’t followed Jezebel’s teaching, and you haven’t learned what some people call “Satan’s deep secrets.”
I’m not asking you to do anything else except to hold on to what you have until I come.
‘If anyone wins the victory and does my will to the end, I’ll give that person authority over the nations,
just as I’ve received authority from my Father. “They will rule them with an iron scepter and break them to pieces like clay pots.”
I’ll also give the morning star to anyone who wins the victory.
Whoever has ears should listen to what the Spirit is saying to the churches.’

verses.heading: The Letter to the Church in Sardis / The Letter to the Church in Sardis
verses.text: “Write this to the angel of the church in Sardis: These are the words of the one who holds the seven spirits of God and has the seven stars in his hand. ‘I know what you’ve been doing. You have a reputation for being alive, but you’re dead.
Wake up! Strengthen what’s left and is about to die. I haven’t found that you’ve done everything my God wants you to do.
So remember what you’ve been taught and what you’ve heard. Hold firmly to it and turn away from your sins. If you don’t wake up, I’ll come like a thief, and you won’t know when I’m coming to you.
‘But you have a few people there in Sardis who haven’t gotten their clothes dirty. They will walk with me dressed in white, because they deserve to.
If anyone wins the victory, I’ll give that person white clothes to wear, and I’ll never erase their name from the book of life. I’ll speak of them by name to my Father and his angels.
Whoever has ears should listen to what the Spirit is saying to the churches.’

verses.heading: The Letter to the Church in Philadelphia / The Letter to the Church in Philadelphia
verses.text: “Write this to the angel of the church in Philadelphia: These are the words of the one who is holy and true, who holds the key of David. No one can shut what he opens, and no one can open what he shuts.
‘I know what you’ve been doing. Look! I’ve opened a door in front of you, and no one can shut it. I know you don’t have much strength, but you’ve obeyed my word, and you haven’t denied me.

Some people claim that they’re Jews, but they’re not. They’re lying. They’re a synagogue of Satan. I’m going to make those people come and fall down at your feet and admit in public that I have loved you.

You’ve kept my command to remain strong in the faith no matter what happens, so I’m going to keep you from the time of suffering that the rest of the world is going to experience. That suffering will test those who live on the earth.
‘I’m coming soon. Hold on to what you have so that no one will take away your crown.

If anyone wins the victory, I’ll make that person a pillar in the temple of my God. They’ll never leave it again. On them I’ll write the name of my God and the name of his city, the new Jerusalem, which is coming down from him out of heaven. I’ll also write my new name on them.
Whoever has ears should listen to what the Spirit is saying to the churches.’

verses.heading: The Letter to the Church in Laodicea / The Letter to the Church in Laodicea
verses.text: “Write this to the angel of the church in Laodicea: The Amen speaks these words. He is the faithful and true witness, the ruler over God’s creation.
‘I know what you’ve been doing. I know you’re not cold and you’re not hot. I wish you were one or the other!
But you’re lukewarm—you’re not hot or cold. So I’m going to spit you out of my mouth.
You say, “I’m rich, I’ve become wealthy, and I don’t need anything.” But you don’t realize that you’re pitiful, miserable, poor, blind, and naked.

So here’s my advice. Buy gold from me that has been purified by fire. Then you’ll become rich. Buy white clothes from me that you can wear to cover the shame of your naked bodies. And buy healing lotion from me to put on your eyes so that you’ll be able to see.
‘I warn and correct those I love. So be eager to do what’s right and turn away from your sins.
Here I am! I’ll keep standing at the door and knocking. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I’ll come in and eat with that person, and they’ll eat with me.
‘If anyone wins the victory, I’ll give that person the right to sit with me on my throne, just as I won the victory and sat down with my Father on his throne.
Whoever has ears should listen to what the Spirit is saying to the churches.’ ”

verses.heading: The Throne in Heaven / The Throne in Heaven
verses.text: After this I looked, and I saw that the door to heaven was open. And I heard the voice that I’d heard before, the one that had sounded like a trumpet, saying, “Come up here, and I’ll show you what must happen after this.”
At once I was in the Spirit, and there in front of me I saw a throne in heaven with someone sitting on it.
The one who sat there shone like precious stones, like jasper and ruby. Around the throne there was a rainbow that shone like an emerald.
All around the throne there were 24 other thrones, and 24 elders were sitting on them. The elders were dressed in white, and they had gold crowns on their heads.
From the central throne came flashes of lightning, loud noises, and thunder. Seven lamps were blazing in front of it; these are the seven spirits of God.

In front of the throne there was also something that looked like a sea of glass, clear as crystal. In the inner circle, around the throne, were four living creatures. They were covered with eyes in front and in back.
The first creature looked like a lion, the second looked like an ox, the third had a man’s face, and the fourth looked like a flying eagle.

Each of the four living creatures had six wings, and each creature was covered all over with eyes, even under its wings. Day and night they never stop saying, “ ‘Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty,’ who was, and is, and is to come.”
Whenever the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to the one who sits on the throne, who lives for ever and ever,
the 24 elders fall down and worship the one who sits on the throne, who lives for ever and ever. They lay their crowns in front of the throne and say,
“You are worthy, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, because you created all things, and by your will they were created and came into existence.”

verses.heading: Who Can Open and Read the Scroll? / Who Can Open and Read the Scroll?
verses.text: Then I saw that the one who was sitting on the throne was holding a scroll in his right hand. The scroll had writing on both sides, and it was sealed with seven seals.
I saw a mighty angel calling out in a loud voice, “Who is worthy to break the seals and open the scroll?”
But no one in heaven or on earth or under the earth could open the scroll and read what it said.
I cried and cried because no one could be found who was worthy to open the scroll and read it.
But one of the elders said to me, “Don’t cry! The Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has won the victory, and he is able to break the seven seals and open the scroll.”

And then I saw, in the center of the area around the throne, surrounded by the four living creatures and the elders, a Lamb. He looked as if he had been put to death. He had seven horns and seven eyes, which stand for the seven spirits of God that are sent out into all the earth.
The Lamb went and took the scroll from the right hand of the one who was sitting on the throne.

Then the four living creatures and the 24 elders fell down in front of the Lamb. Each one had a harp, and they were holding golden bowls full of incense. These bowls stand for the prayers of God’s people.

They sang a new song that said, “You are worthy to take the scroll and break open its seals, because you were put to death, and you bought people for God with your blood. They come from every tribe, language, race, and nation.
You’ve made one kingdom out of them, and you’ve made them priests who will serve our God and rule on the earth.”
Then I looked, and there were countless millions of angels surrounding the throne and the living creatures and the elders.
They were all shouting together, “The Lamb who was put to death is worthy to receive power and wealth and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and praise!”

Then I heard every creature in heaven, on earth, under the earth, and in the ocean—the entire creation—speaking and saying, “Praise and honor and glory and power belong to the one who sits on the throne and to the Lamb for ever and ever!”
The four living creatures said, “Amen,” and the elders fell down and worshiped.

verses.heading: The Lamb Breaks the Seals of the Scroll / The Lamb Breaks the Seals of the Scroll
verses.text: I watched as the Lamb broke open the first of the seven seals. Then I heard one of the four living creatures say in a voice that sounded like thunder, “Come!”
I looked, and there in front of me was a white horse! Its rider held a bow in his hands. He was given a crown, and he rode off to conquer.
When the Lamb broke open the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, “Come!”
Another horse came out that was red like fire. Its rider was given power to take peace from the earth and to make people kill each other. He was given a large sword.
When the Lamb broke open the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come!” I looked, and there in front of me was a black horse! Its rider was holding a pair of scales in his hand.

Then I heard what sounded like a voice coming from among the four living creatures. It said, “Two pounds of wheat for a day’s pay, and six pounds of barley for a day’s pay, but don’t damage the olive oil or the wine!”
When the Lamb broke open the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, “Come!”

I looked, and there in front of me was a pale horse! Its rider’s name was Death, and Hades was following close behind him. They were given power over a quarter of the world, to kill people with swords, hunger, sickness, and wild animals.
When the Lamb broke open the fifth seal, under the altar I saw the souls of people who had been killed because of God’s word and their faithful witness.
They called out in a loud voice, “How long, Lord and King, holy and true, will you wait to judge those who live on the earth? How long will it be until you pay them back for killing us?”
Then each of them was given a white robe and they were told to wait a little longer, because there were still more of their believing brothers and sisters who had to be killed just as they had been.
I watched as the Lamb broke open the sixth seal. There was a powerful earthquake. The sun turned black like sackcloth made out of goat’s hair. The whole moon turned blood red,
and the stars in the sky fell to earth the way figs fall from a tree that’s shaken by a strong wind.
The sky rolled back like a scroll, and every mountain and island was moved out of its place.
Everyone hid in caves and among the rocks of the mountains. Then the kings of the earth, the princes and the generals, the rich and powerful people, and everyone else, both slave and free,
called out to the mountains and rocks. They cried, “Fall on us! Hide us from the face of the one who sits on the throne and from the anger of the Lamb!
The great day of their anger has come, and who can live through it?”

verses.heading: Angels Mark 144,000 People With the Seal of the Living God / Angels Mark 144,000 People With the Seal of the Living God
verses.text: After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth. They were holding back the four winds of the earth and keeping them from blowing on the land or the sea or on any tree.
Then I saw another angel coming up from the east. He brought the official seal of the living God. He called out in a loud voice to the four angels who’d been allowed to harm the land and the sea,
“Don’t harm the land or the sea or the trees until we use this seal to mark the foreheads of those who serve our God.”
Then I heard how many people were marked with the seal: It was 144,000 people, from all the tribes of Israel.
From the tribe of Judah, 12,000 were marked with the seal. From the tribe of Reuben, there were 12,000. From the tribe of Gad, there were 12,000.
From the tribe of Asher, there were 12,000. From the tribe of Naphtali, there were 12,000. From the tribe of Manasseh, there were 12,000.
From the tribe of Simeon, there were 12,000. From the tribe of Levi, there were 12,000. From the tribe of Issachar, there were 12,000.
From the tribe of Zebulun, there were 12,000. From the tribe of Joseph, there were 12,000. From the tribe of Benjamin, there were 12,000.

verses.heading: The Huge Crowd Wearing White Robes / The Huge Crowd Wearing White Robes
verses.text: After this I looked, and I saw a huge crowd of people in front of me. They stood in front of the throne and in front of the Lamb. There were so many that no one could count them. They came from every nation, tribe, race, and language. They were wearing white robes and holding palm branches in their hands.
They cried out in a loud voice, “Salvation belongs to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb.”
All the angels were standing around the throne and the elders and the four living creatures. They fell down on their faces in front of the throne and worshiped God.
They said, “Amen! May praise and glory and wisdom and thanks and honor and power and strength be given to our God for ever and ever. Amen!”
Then one of the elders asked me, “Who are these people dressed in white robes, and where did they come from?”
I answered, “Sir, you know.” He said, “They’re the ones who’ve come out of the time of terrible suffering. They’ve washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
Therefore, “they stand in front of the throne of God and serve him day and night in his temple. The one who sits on the throne will be with them to protect them.
‘They won’t ever be hungry again, and they won’t ever be thirsty again. The sun won’t beat down on them,’ and the heat of the desert won’t harm them.
The Lamb in the center of the area around the throne will be their shepherd. ‘He will lead them to springs of living water,’ ‘and God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.’ ”

verses.heading: The Seventh Seal and the Gold Cup / The Seventh Seal and the Gold Cup
verses.text: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
Then I saw seven trumpets being given to the seven angels who stand in front of God.

Another angel came and stood at the altar. He had a shallow gold cup for burning incense. He was given a large amount of incense to offer on the golden altar in front of the throne. With the incense he offered the prayers of all of God’s people.
The smoke of the incense rose up from the angel’s hand, and the prayers of God’s people rose up together with it in front of God.
Then the angel took the gold cup, filled it with fire from the altar, and threw it down on the earth, and there was thunder, loud noises, flashes of lightning, and an earthquake.

verses.heading: The Trumpets / The Trumpets
verses.text: Then the seven angels who had the seven trumpets got ready to blow them.

The first angel blew his trumpet, and hail and fire mixed with blood were thrown down onto the earth. A third of the earth was burned up, a third of the trees were burned up, and all of the green grass was burned up.
The second angel blew his trumpet, and something that looked like a huge mountain burning with fire was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned into blood,
a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
The third angel blew his trumpet, and a great star that looked like a blazing torch fell from the sky. It fell on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water.
The star is named Wormwood. A third of the water turned bitter, and many people died from it.

The fourth angel blew his trumpet, and a third of the sun was struck, a third of the moon was struck, and a third of the stars were struck, so that a third of each of them turned dark. Then a third of the day was without light, and so was a third of the night.
As I watched, I heard an eagle that was flying high in the air call out in a loud voice, “Woe! Woe! Woe to those living on the earth when the next three angels blow their trumpets!”
The fifth angel blew his trumpet, and I saw a star that had fallen from the sky to the earth. The star was given the key to the tunnel leading down into the Abyss, which is a bottomless pit.
The star opened the Abyss, and smoke rose up from it like the smoke from a huge furnace. It made the sun and sky go dark.
Locusts came out of the smoke down onto the earth, and they were given power like the power of scorpions that live on the earth.
They were told not to harm the grass or any plant or tree, but only the people who didn’t have God’s official seal on their foreheads.
They weren’t allowed to kill those people, but they could hurt them over and over again for five months. Those people suffered pain like the sting of a scorpion when it strikes.
In those days, people will look for a way to die, but they won’t find it. They will long to die, but they won’t be able to.
The locusts looked like horses ready for battle. On their heads they wore something like crowns of gold. Their faces looked like human faces,
their hair was like women’s hair, and their teeth were like lions’ teeth.
Their chests were covered with something that looked like armor made out of iron. The sound of their wings was like the thundering of many horses and chariots rushing into battle.
They had tails that could sting people the way scorpions’ tails do. That gave them the power to hurt people over and over again for five months.
The angel of the Abyss was their king. In Hebrew his name is Abaddon, and in Greek it’s Apollyon, which means Destroyer.
The first terrible judgment is past, but two others are still coming.
The sixth angel blew his trumpet, and I heard a voice coming from the four corners of the golden altar that stands in front of God.
The voice said to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Release the four angels who are being held near the great river Euphrates.”
Those four angels were being kept ready for this very hour and day and month and year. They were released to kill a third of all people.
There was an army of troops on horseback, and I heard someone say that it had 200,000,000 soldiers.

The horses and riders I saw in my vision had armor on their chests that was red like fire, dark blue, and yellow like sulfur. The heads of the horses looked like lions’ heads. Out of their mouths came fire, smoke, and sulfur.
A third of all people were killed by the three plagues of fire, smoke, and sulfur that came out of the horses’ mouths.
The horses had power both in their mouths and in their tails, because their tails were like snakes with heads inflicting injuries.

The people who weren’t killed by these plagues still didn’t stop what they’d been doing. They didn’t stop worshiping demons and idols made out of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood. Those idols can’t see or hear or walk.
The people also didn’t stop their murders, witchcraft, sexual sins, and stealing.

verses.heading: The Angel and the Little Scroll / The Angel and the Little Scroll
verses.text: Then I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven. He was wearing a cloud like a robe and there was a rainbow above his head. His face was like the sun, and his legs were like pillars of fire.
He was holding a little scroll that was lying open in his hand. The angel put his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land,
and he gave a loud shout like the roar of a lion. When he shouted, the voices of the seven thunders spoke.
I was about to write down what they said when they spoke, but I heard a voice from heaven tell me, “Seal up what the seven thunders said, and don’t write it down.”
Then the angel I’d seen standing on the sea and on the land raised his right hand to heaven
and swore an oath in the name of the God who lives for ever and ever, who created the sky, earth, and sea and everything in them. The angel said, “There won’t be any more delay!
When the seventh angel blows his trumpet, God’s plan will be carried out, just as he told the prophets who served him long ago.”
Then the voice I’d heard from heaven spoke to me again. It told me, “Go and take the scroll that’s lying open in the hand of the angel who’s standing on the sea and on the land.”
So I went to the angel and asked him to give me the little scroll. He told me, “Take it and eat it. It will become sour in your stomach, but ‘in your mouth it will taste as sweet as honey.’ ”
I took the little scroll from the angel’s hand, and I ate it. In my mouth it tasted as sweet as honey, but when I’d eaten it, it became sour in my stomach.
Then I was told, “You must prophesy again about many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.”

verses.heading: The Two Witnesses / The Two Witnesses
verses.text: I was given a long stick that looked like a measuring rod, and I was told, “Go and measure the temple of God and the altar where the people are worshiping.
But don’t measure the outer courtyard, because it has been given to the Gentiles. They will take over the holy city for 42 months.
I’ll appoint my two witnesses, and they’ll prophesy for 1,260 days. They’ll be dressed in the rough clothes people wear when they’re sad.”
These witnesses are “the two olive trees” and the two lampstands, and “they stand in front of the Lord of the earth.”
If anyone tries to harm them, fire comes from their mouths and consumes their enemies. This is how anyone who wants to harm them must die.

These witnesses have the power to close up the sky so that it won’t rain during the time when they’re prophesying. They also have the power to turn the rivers and the sea into blood and to strike the earth with every kind of plague as often as they want.
When they’ve finished giving their testimony, the beast that comes up from the Abyss will attack them. He’ll overpower them and kill them.
Their bodies will lie in the main street of the great city where their Lord was nailed to a cross. That city is sometimes compared to Sodom and Egypt.
For three and a half days, people from every race, tribe, language, and nation will look at their bodies and refuse to bury them.
Those who live on the earth will gloat over them and celebrate by sending each other gifts, because those two prophets made them suffer.
But after the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered the witnesses. They both stood up, and those who saw them were terrified.
Then the two witnesses heard a loud voice from heaven that told them, “Come up here.” Then they were taken up to heaven in a cloud while their enemies looked on.

At that same time there was a powerful earthquake, and a tenth of the city collapsed. In the earthquake, 7,000 people were killed. Those who lived through it were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.
The second terrible judgment has passed. The third one is coming soon.

verses.heading: The Seventh Trumpet / The Seventh Trumpet
verses.text: The seventh angel blew his trumpet, and there were loud voices in heaven. They said, “The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of his Messiah, and he will rule for ever and ever.”
The 24 elders were sitting on their thrones in front of God, and they fell on their faces and worshiped God.
They said, “We give you thanks, Lord God Almighty, the God who is and who was, because you’ve taken your great power and you’ve begun to rule.

The nations were angry, and the time for your anger has come. The time has come to judge the dead and to reward your servants the prophets and the saints who honor you, both great and small, and to destroy those who destroy the earth.”

Then God’s temple in heaven was opened, and inside the temple the wooden chest called the ark of his covenant could be seen. There were flashes of lightning, loud noises, thunder, an earthquake, and a severe hailstorm.

verses.heading: The Woman and the Dragon / The Woman and the Dragon
verses.text: A great sign appeared in heaven: a woman wearing the sun as her clothes, with the moon under her feet and a crown of 12 stars on her head.
She was pregnant and cried out in pain because she was about to have a baby.
Then another sign appeared in heaven: a huge red dragon with seven heads and ten horns. On its seven heads it was wearing seven crowns.

The dragon’s tail swept a third of the stars out of the sky and threw them down to the earth. The dragon stood in front of the woman who was about to have a baby, because he wanted to devour her child the moment he was born.
She gave birth to a son, who “will rule all the nations with an iron scepter.” Her child was quickly taken up to God and to his throne,
and the woman escaped into the desert, where God had prepared a place for her. There she would be taken care of for 1,260 days.
Then a war broke out in heaven. Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon and his angels fought back.
But the dragon wasn’t strong enough, so he and his angels lost their place in heaven.
The great dragon was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him. That dragon is the old serpent called the devil, or Satan, who leads the whole world astray.

Then I heard a loud voice in heaven that said, “Now the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our God and the authority of his Messiah have come. The one who makes accusations against our brothers and sisters in front of our God day and night has been thrown down.
They won the victory over him by the blood of the Lamb and by speaking the truth about Jesus to others. They didn’t love their lives so much that they were afraid to die.
So celebrate, you heavens! Be glad, all you who live there! But woe to the earth and the sea! The devil has come down to you, and he’s very angry, because he knows that his time is short.”
When the dragon saw that he’d been thrown down to the earth, he chased the woman who’d given birth to the boy.

The woman was given the two wings of a great eagle so she could fly away to the place prepared for her in the desert. There she would be taken care of for three and a half years, and she’d be out of the serpent’s reach.
Then the serpent spit water out of his mouth like a river. He wanted to catch the woman and sweep her away in the flood.
But the earth helped the woman by opening its mouth and swallowing the river that the dragon had spit out.
The dragon was very angry with the woman, so he went off to fight a war against the rest of her children. They’re all the people who obey God’s commands and speak the truth about Jesus to others.

verses.heading: The Beast Who Comes Out of the Sea / The Beast Who Comes Out of the Sea
verses.text: The dragon stood on the seashore, and I saw a beast coming up out of the sea. It had ten horns and seven heads, and there were ten crowns on its horns. On each head there was a name that was disrespectful and insulting to God.
The beast I saw looked like a leopard, but it had feet like a bear and a mouth like a lion. The dragon gave the beast his power, his throne, and great authority.
One of the beast’s heads seemed to have had a deadly wound, but the wound had been healed. The whole world was amazed and followed the beast.
People worshiped the dragon because he had given authority to the beast, and they also worshiped the beast. They asked, “Who is like the beast? Who can fight it?”
The beast was given a mouth so it could brag about itself and say insulting things about God. The beast was allowed to use its authority for 42 months.
The beast opened its mouth and insulted God, and it insulted his name and the place where he lives and those who live in heaven with him.
The beast was allowed to fight a war against the saints and defeat them. It was given authority over every tribe, race, language, and nation.
Everyone who lives on the earth will worship the beast if their name hasn’t been written in the book of life that belongs to the Lamb, who was willing to be a sacrifice from the time the world began.
Whoever has ears should listen.
“Everyone who’s supposed to be captured will be captured, and everyone who’s supposed to be killed by a sword will be killed by a sword.” So God’s people must be patient and faithful.

verses.heading: The Beast Who Comes Out of the Earth / The Beast Who Comes Out of the Earth
verses.text: Then I saw a second beast. This one came out of the earth. It had two horns like a lamb, but it spoke like a dragon.

This beast had all the authority of the first beast, and it carried out its wishes. It made the earth and everyone who lives on it worship the first beast. The first beast was the one whose deadly wound had been healed.
The second beast performed great signs. It even made fire come from heaven to earth as everyone was watching.

The first beast had given the second beast the power to perform these signs, and by these signs, the second beast tricked those who live on the earth. The second beast ordered people to set up a statue to honor the first beast. The first beast was the one who’d been wounded by a sword but had survived.
The second beast was allowed to breathe life into this statue so that it could speak and kill anyone who refused to worship it.
The statue also forced everyone—great or small, rich or poor, free or slave—to receive a mark on their right hand or on their forehead.
No one could buy or sell anything unless they had the mark, which was the name of the beast or the number of its name.
This will require wisdom and careful thought: Anyone who can solve puzzles should figure out what the beast’s number means. It’s the number of a man, and that number is 666.

verses.heading: The Lamb and the 144,000 / The Lamb and the 144,000
verses.text: I looked, and there in front of me was the Lamb, standing on Mount Zion. He had 144,000 people with him, and they had his name and his Father’s name written on their foreheads.
I heard a sound from heaven like the roar of rushing waters and loud thunder. The sound I heard was like the music of harps being played.
Then everyone sang a new song in front of the throne and the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn the song except the 144,000 who’d been rescued from the earth.
They hadn’t committed sexual sins; they’d kept themselves pure. They follow the Lamb wherever he goes. They were purchased from among human beings as a first offering to God and the Lamb.
They weren’t found guilty of lying or of doing anything else wrong.

verses.heading: The Three Angels / The Three Angels
verses.text: Then I saw another angel flying high in the air. He came to announce the never-ending good news to everyone on earth—to every nation, tribe, language, and race.
In a loud voice he said, “Show respect for God and give him glory, because the time has come for him to judge. Worship him who made the heavens, the earth, the sea, and the springs of water.”
A second angel followed him and said, “ ‘Fallen! Babylon the Great has fallen!’ This is the city that made all the nations drink the strong wine of her terrible sins.”
A third angel followed them and said in a loud voice, “If anyone worships the beast and its statue and receives its mark on their forehead or their hand,

they too will drink the wine of God’s great anger! His wine has been poured full strength into the cup of his anger. They will be burned with flaming sulfur, and the holy angels and the Lamb will witness their punishment.
The smoke of their terrible suffering will rise for ever and ever. Day and night, there will be no rest for anyone who worships the beast and its statue or who receives the mark of its name.”
This should encourage God’s people, who obey his commands, to be very patient and remain faithful to Jesus.

Then I heard a voice from heaven say, “Write this: Blessed are the dead who die as believers in the Lord from now on.” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “they will rest from their labor, and they’ll be rewarded for what they’ve done.”

verses.heading: The Harvest of the Earth / The Harvest of the Earth
verses.text: I looked, and there in front of me was a white cloud. Someone who looked “like a son of man” was sitting on the cloud, and he was wearing a gold crown on his head. In his hand was a sharp, curved sickle for cutting crops.

Then another angel came out of the temple and called out in a loud voice to the one who was sitting on the cloud, “Take your sickle and cut the grain. The time has come to do that, because the earth is ready to be harvested.”
So the one who was sitting on the cloud swung his sickle over the earth, and it was harvested.
Another angel came out of the temple in heaven. He also had a sharp sickle.

Still another angel, who was in charge of the fire on the altar, came out and called out in a loud voice to the angel who had the sharp sickle. “Take your sharp sickle,” he said, “and gather the bunches of grapes from the earth’s vine, because they’re ripe.”
So the angel swung his sickle over the earth and gathered its grapes, and then he threw them into a huge winepress. The winepress stands for God’s anger.
When the grapes were crushed in the winepress outside the city, blood flowed out and spread over the land for about 180 miles. It rose as high as a horse’s head.

verses.heading: Seven Angels With Seven Plagues / Seven Angels With Seven Plagues
verses.text: I saw another great and amazing sign in heaven. Seven angels were about to bring the seven last plagues that would complete God’s anger.

Then I saw something that looked like a sea of glass glowing with fire. Those who had won the battle over the beast were standing next to the sea. They had also overcome the beast’s statue and the number of its name. They held harps that God had given them,
and they sang the song of God’s servant Moses and of the Lamb. They sang, “Lord God Almighty, everything you do is great and amazing. King of the nations, your ways are true and fair.
Lord, who won’t show you respect and bring glory to your name? You alone are holy. All nations will come and worship you, because they’ll see that the things you do are right.”
After this I looked and saw that the temple in heaven was open. The temple is the holy tent where the tablets of the covenant law were kept.
The seven angels who were bringing the seven plagues came out of the temple. They were dressed in clean, shining linen, and they had gold strips of cloth around their chests.
Then one of the four living creatures gave seven golden bowls to the seven angels. The bowls were filled with the anger of God, who lives for ever and ever.
The temple was filled with smoke that came from the glory and power of God, and no one could enter the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed.

verses.heading: The Seven Bowls of God’s Great Anger / The Seven Bowls of God’s Great Anger
verses.text: Then I heard a loud voice from the temple saying to the seven angels, “Go, pour out the seven bowls of God’s great anger on the earth.”
The first angel went and poured out his bowl on the land. Horrid, painful sores broke out on people who had the mark of the beast and who worshiped its statue.
The second angel poured out his bowl on the sea. It turned into blood like the blood of a dead person, and every living thing in the sea died.
