The third angel poured out his bowl on the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.
Then I heard the angel who was in charge of the waters say, “Holy One, the way you judge is fair, you who are and who were,
because they’ve shed the blood of saints and prophets, and you’ve given them blood to drink, which is what they deserve.”
Then I heard the altar reply. It said, “Yes, Lord God Almighty, the way you judge is true and fair.”
The fourth angel poured out his bowl on the sun, which was allowed to burn people with fire.
They were burned by the blazing heat, and they spoke curses against the name of God, who had power over these plagues. But they refused to turn away from their sins and admit that God was right.
The fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and its kingdom became very dark. People chewed on their tongues because they were suffering so much.
They spoke curses against the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores. But they still refused to turn away from the sins they were committing.
The sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great river Euphrates, and its water dried up to prepare the way for the kings from the East.
Then I saw three evil spirits that looked like frogs. They came out of the mouths of the dragon, the beast, and the false prophet.
They’re spirits of demons that perform signs, and they go out to gather the kings of the whole world for battle. This battle will take place on the great day of God Almighty.
“Look! I’m coming like a thief! Blessed is anyone who stays awake and keeps their clothes on. Then they’ll be ready, and they won’t be caught naked and be embarrassed.”
Then the evil spirits gathered the kings together to the place that’s called Armageddon in Hebrew.
The seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air, and out of the temple a loud voice came from the throne and said, “It is done!”

Then there came flashes of lightning, loud noises, thunder, and a powerful earthquake. In the whole time that human beings have lived on earth, there has never been an earthquake as terrible and powerful as that one.
The great city split into three parts, and the cities of the nations collapsed. God remembered Babylon the Great and gave her the cup filled with the wine of his terrible anger.
Every island vanished from sight and the mountains disappeared.
Huge hailstones weighing about 100 pounds each fell from the sky and crushed anyone they hit. People spoke curses against God because the plague of hail was so terrible.

verses.heading: Babylon the Great Prostitute Sits on the Beast / Babylon the Great Prostitute Sits on the Beast
verses.text: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came to me and said, “Come, I’ll show you how the great prostitute is going be punished. She’s the one who sits on many waters.
The kings of the earth took part in the wrong things she did, and the people living on earth became drunk with the wine of her terrible sins.”

Then the angel carried me away in the Spirit to a desert. There I saw a woman sitting on a bright red beast that was covered with names that said insulting things about God. The beast had seven heads and ten horns.
The woman was dressed in purple and bright red, and she was gleaming with gold, jewels, and pearls. In her hand she held a golden cup filled with things that God hates—her appalling, repulsive sins.
The name written on her forehead was a mystery. Here’s what it said. the great city of babylon the mother of prostitutes the mother of everything on earth that god hates
I saw that the woman was drunk with the blood of the saints, those who are witnesses about Jesus. When I saw her, I was very amazed.

Then the angel said to me, “Why are you so amazed? I’ll explain the mystery of the woman to you, and I’ll explain the mystery of the beast she rides on, the one that has the seven heads and ten horns.

The beast that you saw used to exist, but now it doesn’t, and yet it will come up out of the Abyss and then be destroyed. Anyone living on the earth whose name has not been written in the book of life from the time the world was created will be amazed when they see the beast, because it will come again, even though it used to exist but now it doesn’t.
“Here’s a problem needing wisdom and careful thinking. The seven heads are seven hills that the woman sits on.
They’re also seven kings. Five have died, one is ruling, and the other has still not come. When he does come, he will remain for only a little while.
The beast who used to exist, but doesn’t anymore, is an eighth king. He belongs to the other seven, and he will be destroyed.
“The ten horns you saw are ten kings. They haven’t yet begun to rule, but for a short time they will receive authority to rule together with the beast.
They will all agree about what they want to do, so they’ll give their power and authority to the beast.

They’ll fight a war against the Lamb, but the Lamb will win the victory over them. That’s because he’s the most powerful Lord of all and the greatest King of all. His appointed, chosen, and faithful followers will be with him.”
Then the angel said to me, “The waters you saw, which the prostitute was sitting on, stand for the races, multitudes, nations, and languages of the world.
The beast and the ten horns you saw will hate the prostitute. They’ll destroy her and take away her expensive clothes; they’ll devour her flesh and burn her with fire.
God has put it into their hearts to carry out his purpose by agreeing to give the beast their royal authority until God’s words come true.
The woman you saw stands for the great city that rules over the kings of the earth.”

verses.heading: Weeping When Babylon Falls / Weeping When Babylon Falls
verses.text: After these things I saw another angel coming down from heaven. He had great authority, and his glory lit up the earth.

With a mighty voice he shouted, “ ‘Fallen! Babylon the Great has fallen!’ She has become a place where demons live, a den for every evil spirit, a home for every unclean bird, a home for every unclean and untouchable animal.
All the nations have drunk the strong wine of her terrible sins. The kings of the earth took part in the wrong things she did, and the traders of the world grew rich from her great wealth.”

verses.heading: Warning to Run From Babylon’s Judgment / Warning to Run From Babylon’s Judgment
verses.text: Then I heard another voice from heaven that said, “ ‘Come out of her, my people,’ so that you don’t take part in her sins and you don’t suffer from any of her plagues.
Her sins are piled up to heaven and God has remembered her crimes.
Do to her what she has done to others; pay her back double for what she has done. Pour her a double dose of what she has poured out for others.
Give her as much pain and suffering as she gave glory and wealth to herself. She brags in her heart, ‘I rule on a throne like a queen. I’m not a widow; I’ll never mourn.’
But she’ll be plagued by death, sadness, and hunger. In a single day she’ll suffer all these plagues. She’ll be burned up by fire, because the Lord God who judges her is mighty.

verses.heading: Three Woes for the Fall of Babylon / Three Woes for the Fall of Babylon
verses.text: “When the kings of the earth who committed terrible sins with her and shared in her riches see the smoke rising as she burns, they’ll weep and mourn.
They’ll be terrified by her suffering, and they’ll stand far away from her and cry out, “ ‘Woe! Woe to you, great city, you mighty city of Babylon! In just one hour you’ve been destroyed!’
“The traders of the world will weep and mourn over her, because everyone will stop buying what they have for sale:
“Gold, silver, jewels, and pearls; fine linen, purple, silk, and bright red cloth; every kind of citron wood; all sorts of things made out of ivory, valuable wood, bronze, iron, and marble;
cinnamon, spices, incense, myrrh, and frankincense; wine, olive oil, fine flour, and wheat; cattle, sheep, horses, wagons, and human beings sold as slaves.
“The merchants will say, ‘The pleasures you longed for have left you. All your luxuries and comforts have disappeared forever.’
The traders who sold these things became rich because of Babylon. They’ll stand far away, terrified by her suffering, and they’ll weep and mourn
and cry out, “ ‘Woe! Woe to you, great city, dressed in fine linen, purple, and bright red, and gleaming with gold, jewels, and pearls!
In just one hour your great wealth has been destroyed!’ “Every sea captain and passenger, every sailor and merchant, will stand far away.
When they see the smoke rising as Babylon burns, they’ll ask, ‘Was there ever a city like this great city?’

They’ll throw dust on their heads and weep and mourn and cry out, “ ‘Woe! Woe to you, great city! All who had ships on the sea became rich because of her wealth! In just one hour she has been destroyed!’
“Celebrate this, you heavens! Celebrate, people of God! Celebrate, apostles and prophets! God has judged her with the same judgment she passed against you.”

verses.heading: Babylon’s Judgment Is Final / Babylon’s Judgment Is Final
verses.text: Then a mighty angel picked up a giant rock the size of a large millstone. He threw it into the sea and said, “The great city of Babylon will plunge to its ruin just like that, not leaving any trace.
The music of harps, flutes, and trumpets will never be heard in you again. No worker of any kind will ever be found in you again. The sound of a millstone

The light of a lamp will never shine in you again. The voices of brides and grooms will never be heard in you again. Your traders were among the world’s most powerful people, and by your magic spell, all the nations were led astray.
You were guilty of the murder of prophets and saints. You were guilty of the blood of all who’ve been killed on the earth.”

verses.heading: Three Hallelujahs for the Fall of Babylon! / Three Hallelujahs for the Fall of Babylon!
verses.text: After these things I heard a roar in heaven that sounded like a huge crowd. They were shouting, “Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God,
because the way he judges is true and fair. He has punished the great prostitute who made the earth impure with her terrible sins. God has paid her back for shedding the blood of his servants.”
Again they shouted, “Hallelujah! The smoke from her fire goes up for ever and ever.”
The 24 elders and the four living creatures bowed down and worshiped God, who was sitting on the throne. They cried out, “Amen! Hallelujah!”
Then a voice came from the throne. It said, “Praise our God, all you who serve him! Praise God, all you who have respect for him, both great and small!”
Then I heard the noise of a huge crowd. It sounded like the roar of rushing waters and like loud thunder. The people were shouting, “Hallelujah! The Lord our God is the King who rules over all.
Let’s celebrate and be happy! Let’s give him glory! It’s time for the Lamb’s wedding, and his bride has put on her dress.
Fine linen, bright and clean, was given to her to wear.” (Fine linen stands for the just and fair things that the saints do.)
Then the angel told me, “Write this: Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb!” Then he added, “These are the true words of God.”

When I heard this, I fell at his feet to worship him. But he said to me, “Don’t do that! I’m God’s servant, just like you and your brothers and sisters who hold firmly to what Jesus taught. Worship God! The Spirit of prophecy tells the truth about Jesus.”

verses.heading: The Heavenly Warrior Has Victory Over the Beast / The Heavenly Warrior Has Victory Over the Beast
verses.text: Then I saw heaven open up, and there was a white horse in front of me. Its rider is called Faithful and True. When he judges or fights a war, he’s always fair.
His eyes are like blazing fire, and he has many crowns on his head. He has a name written on him that only he knows.
He’s dressed in a robe that has been dipped in blood. His name is the Word of God.
The armies of heaven were following him, riding on white horses. They were dressed in fine linen, white and clean.

The rider has a sharp sword coming out of his mouth. He’ll use it to strike down the nations. “He will rule them with an iron scepter.” He crushes the grapes in the winepress of the terrible anger of God Almighty.
This is the name that’s written on the rider’s robe and on his thigh: King of Kings and Lord of Lords.
Then I saw an angel standing in the sun. He called out to all the birds that were flying high in the air, “Come, gather together for the great supper that God is serving.
Come and eat the flesh of kings, generals, and other mighty people, of horses and their riders, and of all people, free and slave, great and small.”
Then I saw the beast and the kings of the earth with their armies. They had gathered together to fight a war against the rider on the horse and his army.

But the beast was captured, along with the false prophet who’d done signs for the beast. With those signs the false prophet had deceived those who’d received the mark of the beast and worshiped its statue. The beast and the false prophet were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur.
The rest of their army was killed by the sword that came out of the rider’s mouth. And the birds feasted on their dead bodies until they couldn’t eat any more.

verses.heading: The Thousand Years / The Thousand Years
verses.text: I saw an angel coming down out of heaven. He had the key to the Abyss, and he held a heavy chain in his hand.
He seized the dragon, that old serpent, who is the devil, or Satan, and he put him in chains for 1,000 years.
He threw him into the Abyss, locked it, and sealed him in. This was to keep Satan from deceiving the nations anymore until the 1,000 years had ended. After that, he must be set free for a short time.

I saw thrones, and those who had been given authority to judge were sitting on them. I also saw the souls of those who had been beheaded because they’d spoken the truth about Jesus and the word of God. They hadn’t worshiped the beast or its statue, and they hadn’t received its mark on their foreheads or hands. They came to life and ruled with Christ for 1,000 years.
This is the first resurrection. The rest of the dead didn’t come to life until the 1,000 years were over.
Blessed and holy are those who share in the first resurrection! The second death has no power over them. They will be priests of God and of Christ, and they will rule with him for 1,000 years.

verses.heading: Satan Is Judged / Satan Is Judged
verses.text: When the 1,000 years are over, Satan will be set free from his prison.

He’ll go out to deceive the nations that are in the four corners of the earth—Gog and Magog—and he’ll gather them together for battle. They’ll have as many troops as the grains of sand on the seashore.
In my vision I watched as they marched across the whole earth. They surrounded the place where the saints were camped, the city God loves. But fire came down from heaven and burned them up.
The devil who had deceived them was thrown into the lake of burning sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet had been thrown. They will all suffer day and night for ever and ever.

verses.heading: The Dead Are Judged / The Dead Are Judged
verses.text: I saw a great white throne, and I saw the one who was sitting on it. When the earth and sky saw his face, they ran away and disappeared.

I saw the dead, both great and small, standing in front of the throne. Books were opened, and then another book was opened, which was the book of life. The dead were judged by what they’d done, which had been recorded in the books.
The sea gave up the dead that were in it, and Death and Hades gave up their dead. Each person was judged by what they’d done.
Then Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. The lake of fire is the second death.
Anyone whose name wasn’t written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.

verses.heading: A New Heaven and a New Earth / A New Heaven and a New Earth
verses.text: Then I saw “a new heaven and a new earth.” The first heaven and the first earth had vanished, and there was no longer any sea.
I saw the Holy City, the new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God like a bride dressed beautifully for her husband.
And I heard a loud voice from the throne that said, “Look! God will now make his home among the people.

He will live with them, and they’ll be his people, and God himself will be with them and be their God. ‘He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death’ or sadness or crying or pain, because these things are gone forever.”
The one who was sitting on the throne said, “I’m making everything new!” Then he said, “Write this down. You can trust these words, because they’re true.”
He said to me, “It’s done. I’m the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. If anyone is thirsty, I’ll give them water for free from the spring of the water of life.
Those who win the victory will receive all this from me. I’ll be their God, and they’ll be my children.

But others will be thrown into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur: cowards, unbelievers, and murderers; those who are impure or commit sexual sins or practice witchcraft; those who worship idols; and all liars. The lake of fire is the second death.”

verses.heading: The New Jerusalem Is the Bride of the Lamb / The New Jerusalem Is the Bride of the Lamb
verses.text: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls filled with the seven last plagues came and said to me, “Come, I’ll show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb.”
Then he carried me away in the Spirit to a great, high mountain. He showed me Jerusalem, the Holy City, coming down out of heaven from God.
It shone with the glory of God, and it gleamed like a very valuable jewel, like a jasper, as clear as crystal.
The city had a great, high wall with 12 gates and with 12 angels at the gates. The names of the 12 tribes of Israel were written on the gates.
There were three gates on the east, three on the north, three on the south, and three on the west.
The wall of the city had 12 foundations, and the names of the 12 apostles of the Lamb were written on them.
The angel who talked with me had a gold measuring rod that he used to measure the city, its gates, and its walls.
The city was laid out like a square; it was as long as it was wide.

The angel measured the city with the rod, and he found that it was 1,400 miles long and that it was as wide and high as it was long. The angel measured the thickness of the wall and found that it was more than 200 feet thick, according to human measurements.
The wall was made out of jasper, and the city was made out of pure gold, as pure as glass.

The foundations of the city walls were decorated with every kind of jewel. The first foundation was made out of jasper. The second was made out of sapphire. The third was made out of agate. The fourth was made out of emerald.

The fifth was made out of onyx. The sixth was made out of ruby. The seventh was made out of chrysolite. The eighth was made out of beryl. The ninth was made out of topaz. The tenth was made out of turquoise. The eleventh was made out of jacinth. The twelfth was made out of amethyst.
The 12 gates were made from 12 pearls; each gate was made out of a single pearl. The main street of the city was made out of gold that was as pure as clear glass.
I didn’t see any temple in the city, because the Lamb and the Lord God Almighty are its temple.
The city doesn’t need the sun or moon to shine on it, because God’s glory is its light and the Lamb is its lamp.
The nations will walk by the light of the city, and the kings of the world will bring their glory into it.
Its gates will never be shut, because there will be no night there.
The glory and honor of the nations will be brought into it.
Only what is pure will enter the city. No one will enter who does anything that’s shameful or deceitful; only those whose names are written in the Lamb’s book of life will enter.

verses.heading: The Earth Is Made Like New Again / The Earth Is Made Like New Again
verses.text: Then the angel showed me the river of the water of life, clear as crystal, flowing down the middle of the city’s main street from the throne of God and of the Lamb. On each side of the river was the tree of life. It bore 12 crops of fruit, a different one each month, and its leaves brought healing to the nations.
There will no longer be any curse. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in the city, and God’s servants will serve him there.
They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.
There will be no more night. They won’t need the light of a lamp or the light of the sun, because the Lord God will give them light. And they will rule for ever and ever.

verses.heading: John and the Angel / John and the Angel
verses.text: The angel said to me, “These words are trustworthy and true. The Lord is the God who gives messages to the prophets, and he has sent his angel to show his servants the things that must take place soon.”
“I’m coming soon! Blessed is the person who obeys the words of prophecy that are written in this book.”
I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. When I’d heard them and seen them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who’d been showing them to me.
But he told me, “Stop! I’m a servant of God, just like you and the other prophets and everyone who obeys the words of this book. Worship God!”
Then he told me, “Don’t seal up the words of the prophecy in this book, because these things are going to happen soon.
Let the person who’s doing wrong keep on doing it, and let the bad person continue to be bad. But let the person who’s doing right keep on doing it, and let the holy person continue to be holy.”

verses.heading: The Revelation Ends With Warnings and Blessings / The Revelation Ends With Warnings and Blessings
verses.text: “See, I’m coming soon, and I’m bringing my rewards with me. I’ll reward each person for what they’ve done.
I’m the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.
“Blessed are those who wash their robes so that they can have the right to eat from the tree of life and go through the gates into the city.
Outside the city are those who are impure, those who practice witchcraft, those who commit sexual sins and murder, those who worship idols, and everyone who loves and does what is false.
“I, Jesus, have sent my angel to give you this witness for the churches. I’m the Root and the Son of David. I’m the bright Morning Star.”
The Holy Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” Let the person who hears say, “Come!” Let the one who is thirsty come and take the free gift of the water of life.
I warn everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book that if anyone adds anything to them, God will add to that person the plagues described in this book.
And if anyone takes away any of the words from this book of prophecy, then God will take away their share in the tree of life and their place in the Holy City, which are also described in this book.
The one who testifies to these things says, “Yes, I’m coming soon.” Amen. Come, Lord Jesus!
May the grace of the Lord Jesus be with God’s people. Amen.
